Hanoi City Tours.title: Hanoi City Tour – 1 Day
Hanoi City Tours.itinerary: AM: 7.45 – 8.15: Free pick up at your hotel. Then visit the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum to explore the architectural and historical aspects of Uncle Ho’s final resting-place. Just next door is Ho Chi Minh’s house on stilts and lying to one side of the Mausoleum is the One Pillar Pagoda, which was founded by King Ly Thai To in 1049 – the structure has become an important symbol for the people of Hanoi. Then continue on to the Buddhist Tran Quoc Pagoda at West lake (One of the oldest pagodas in Vietnam).Then visit Bat Trang pottery village (applied on Mon, Wed & Fri). Lunch at local restaurant. Ba Dinh Square PM: After lunch proceed to visit the Ethnology Museum (apply on Sun, Tue, Thu & Sat), the Literature Temple and Quoc Tu Giam, see Vietnam’s first university, constructed in 1070 – it’s gardens and well-preserved architecture will offer a relaxing glimpse into Vietnam’s past. Take you past Hoan Kiem Lake to see the peaceful waters, and the beauty of Ngoc Son temple. At the end, journey through Hanoi’s Old Quarter, where you’ll then have a chance for some shopping and exploration. Tour ends around 15h30 – 16h00.

Hanoi City Tours.title: Hanoi Half day City Tour
Hanoi City Tours.itinerary:
Tour Itinerary
Duration: 4 hours Pick up: hotel pick-up. This half day city tour Hanoi could be either in the morning or in the afternoon.
Morning Tour 8.30 – 12.30.: Start the tour by visiting Ho Chi Minh complex including Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, his house-on-stilts, the One-Pillar pagoda and continue on to the Temple of Literature – the first university of Vietnam and the place dedicating to Confucian. A Green Car (or cyclo ride) tour around the Old Quarter to experience the exciting local daily life of Hanoians. Stopover to visit the Hoan Kiem Lake. Tour ends after a cup of coffee or tea at an authentic Hanoi corner cafe where you can have talks with local people, exchange cultural way of life.
Afternoon Tour 14.00 – 18.00.: Afternoon Hanoi tour starts visiting the Temple of Literature (or you might choose one of the museums in Hanoi – Hilton Hanoi, Military museum, Museum of History, Ethnology museum..), then move to the West Lake and pay a visit to the oldest pagoda Tran Quoc. Continue drive to Hoan Kiem Lake and the French Quarter (Old Quarter Hanoi), visit The Huc Bridge and Ma May ancient house. A Green Car (or cyclo ride) tour around the Old Quarter to experience the exciting local daily life of Hanoians. Tour ends after a cup of coffee or tea at an authentic Hanoi corner cafe where you can have talks with local people, exchange cultural way of life. End the tour at your hotel.

Street Food Tours.title: Hanoi Street Food Tour – 1 Day
Street Food Tours.itinerary: At 11.30/or 18.00, our tour guide will welcome you at your hotel lobby, then start walking around 4Km in old quarter “36 old streets” to visit some famous and specialized: food families or stalls/ local restaurants, shops where they run their business everyday, certainly you will watch and taste around 6- 8 particular dishes, we can customize vegetarian or special food too. Special thing that tour guide would like to introduce some popular authentic food in lovely mini restaurants (not luxury restaurants) where you feel comfortable to sit down and enjoy some favorite dishes and nice drinks too. It’s interesting to hear from tour guide about the history of the old quarter in Hanoi, it is thousand years old and today retains much of the old flavor that made the area special in earlier times, each street was the exclusive domain of one trade (guilds) so there are whole streets of blacksmiths, silver shops, paper shops, headstone makers and more. Originally there were just 36 old streets in the old quarter but today there are more than 50 streets. It is very difficult to find some local food stalls and mini restaurants on your own in hidden alleys and sidewalks, certainly the best way to make it easy is joining with Go Asia Travel, taking part in this special tour to learn about Vietnamese cuisine, culture, people and language. After all. Food on Foot Tour will give you an unique experience to try the foods of the local Hanoi people, we ensure the food is handled hygienically and provide a comfortable venue for the tastings. The benefit also goes back to the vendors or restaurants/ families as we buy directly from them. At 14.30/or 21.00, our tour guide say goodbye to you, and will help you order taxi or show you direction back your hotel. See you again!

Motorbike Tours.title: Seeing Hanoi on Motorbike tour
Motorbike Tours.itinerary:
Tour Itinerary
Duration: 4 hours Explore Hanoi in a unique and fascinating way and experience the Hanoians’ daily life as well as to try some awesome local foods. Our tour guide picks you up at your hotel in Hanoi downtown. You will then move to get your own motorbike. You can choose your own desire itinerary out of these following options:
Opt 1: Classic Hanoi city
Our tour starts with a visit to the first national university of Vietnam: Temple of Literature – which was built in the 10th century under the Ly Dynasty and greatly influenced by Confucianism. The following stop is Quan Su Pagoda, the head-quarter of Vietnam Buddhist Sangha where many important Vietnamese Buddhist activities are held.
After leaving the architectural and cultural spots, you will experience the daily life of Hanoians at the bustling and noisy Thinh Yen Flea Market. Next, lunch/dinner will be served at a Hanoi traditional restaurant. After a short rest, you will continue your motorbike itinerary to visit the Hanoi 36 Old Streets. Our half: day tour will end at Dong Xuan Market, one of the biggest and oldest markets in Hanoi. You can do some shopping before returning to your hotel. Places to visit is flexible at your disposal, you can choose your desire tourist attractions to go, or advised by our professional guide.
Opt 2: West Lake Route
You will ride a motorbike (or on backseat) to travel a full circle of the West Lake (approximately 17 km). You can choose to visit 3: 4 optional ancient pagodas and temples in the surrounding area, including Tran Quoc, Tu Lien, Tao Sach pagodas and Phu Tay Ho, Mau Lieu Hanh temples. Also, you are set free time to relax in a lakeside coffee shop for some Vietnamese coffee and tea. The best time to go the West Lake Route motorbike tour is in Spring and Autumn when the view of West Lake turns to be romantic and poetic with cool breezes, refreshing smell of grass and the powdered gold sunshine. Your meal also is at your own choice of very traditional cuisine of Hanoi.
Opt 3: Traditional villages – Outskirts Route: This option takes you a bit further out from the center of Hanoi. Especially, the route will surely satisfy those who love to explore Hanoi’s vicinities. Not only focusing on the village, but the our motorbike tour will also offers great opportunity for you to experience Hanoi’s crazy traffic as well as to observe the routine of Vietnamese’s daily life in Hanoi. You can choose one of the following traditional handicraft villages:
(1) Bat Trang Pottery village (2) Van Phuc Silk village (3) Ha Thai Lacquer: ware village (4) Dong Ho Folk Painting village (5) Du Du Sculpture village

Handicraft Village Tours.title: Hanoi City Tour With Incense Village – Train Street – Must-see places With Lunch + Egg Coffee
Handicraft Village Tours.itinerary:
In the morning: From 7:00 to 7:15 am, picking you up at hotels in Hanoi Old Quarter & taking 1,5 hour – drive to Incense Village Quang Phu Cau, there, you can see the process that the artisans make the incense with beautiful color and dry them under the sun and making the best photos ever.
Before 11:30 am: , you will be at Train Street to get ready for taking photos/videos of the train coming back to Hanoi Railway station. This is the most expected part of the trip. Then you have lunch there. You will taste the well-known dishes of Hanoi as Bun Cha & Banh Mi on the street restaurant by the train street.
If you join half day tour, tour guide says goodbye to you at hotel.
In the afternoon
Visiting Hoa Lo Prison which is known as Maison Centrale in Hanoi or the ‘Hanoi Hilton’ which housed Vietnamese revolutionaries & American POW during the Vietnam War, then Temple of Literature: the first university of Vietnam in The 10th Century, learn more about Confucianism and Viet Nam traditional education with Khue Van Pavilion and Doctor Stelas on turtle’s back, visiting Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum (visit the outside of the mausoleum), Ba Dinh Square where president Ho Chi Minh declared Independence of Vietnam on September 2nd, 1945. Driving to West Lake to visit the most ancient pagoda Tran Quoc which was built in 528 to understand about Buddhism in Vietnam. Tour ends with special Egg coffee that you never try before.
17: 30 Dropping you off at your hotels or meeting point. Trip ends. Useful Info   Contact Us

1 Day Cruises.title: Symphony Cruise – 5 Star
1 Day Cruises.itinerary:
THE WORL HERITAGE DISCOVERY HALONG BAY
7: 00 AM – 7:30 AM: Hotel PickUp Our limousine bus will pick you up at all hotels in Hanoi Old Quarter area.
Note: due to the specific traffic conditions in the area( walking streets at weekend), we will try to organize picking up as soon as possible within frame of time. Please, wait at the hotel’s lobby from 7h00. Thanks for the co-operation!
9: 45 AM – 10:00 AM: Boarding the Cruise
You will have a short time to rest at Halong International Marina before boarding. Then, Halong Symphony cruise will welcome you with professional and friendly staffs to begin exploring the World’s Natural Heritage site: Halong bay.
10: 00 AM – 11:30 AM: Cruising
Halong Symphony cruise will take you to explore the poetic beauty of the bay and the wonder of nature. From cruise, you will see hundreds of limestone mountains with countless different shapes and emerald sea water. All converging with the cloud and sky to creat a beautiful, shimmering picture that can make you smile, touch every soul: even the coldest.
11: 30 AM – 12:30 AM: Visiting Sung Sot Cave 
You will leave cruise with tour guide to explore one of the largest and the most beautiful caves of the bay: Surprising cave. Just from first steps leading into the cave, you will gradually feel beauty and mystery what the Nature bestows this cave. Here, our guide will share you interesting and useful informations about destination as an indispensable spice in the dish called Heritage Journey.
2: 00 PM – 2:45 PM: Visiting Luon Cave by kayaking or bamboo boat ( Optional 5$/pax) After having lunch, you will continue your exploration by rowing boat( or kayak) to visit Luon cave. The cave is about 40m of length, which opens an extremely peaceful and secluded valley.
2: 45 PM – 3:30 PM Visiting Titop Island Just after visiting Luon cave, our tender boat will take you all the way to Ti Top island. Here, you will have around 45 minutes to rest or immerse yourself into cool sea water of Halong ay.
Ti Top is a small island which was chosen as a stopover and visiting point on journey of President Ho Chi Minh to welcome Soviet astronaut: Gherman Titov on November 22, 1962. To remember that event,as well as strengthen the friendship between Vietnam and Soviet Union, our Uncle Ho named the island Ti Top.
3: 30 PM – 5:00 PM: Enjoy Afternoon Tea Under the Sunset After participating in outdoor activities, you will come back cruise and begin the journey back marina. Our cruise staffs will set up sunset party during cruising. You will enjoy fruits, cakes and drinks. At this time, staffs and guide will share insights, interact with guests, express gratitude to every one and foster a sense of connection.
5: 00 PM: DISEMBARK AT HALONG INTERNATIONAL MARINA AND TRANSFER BACK HANOI

2 Days / 1 Night Cruises.title: cozy bay grand cruise
2 Days / 1 Night Cruises.itinerary:
cozy bay grand cruise Tour highlights: Experience the beauty of Ha Long Bay aboard the Cozy Bay Grand 4★, where elegant design blends harmoniously with the tranquility of nature. The charming cruise offers a luxurious yet cozy atmosphere, ideal for travelers seeking comfort and authentic experiences on the bay. As you sail past the iconic limestone karsts, you can enjoy relaxing moments, breathtaking scenery, and warm hospitality. Cozy Bay Grand promises a memorable getaway in one of the world’s most stunning destinations.
DAY 1: HANOI – HALONG BAY – TITOV ISLAND – LUON CAVE (L/D): 07:45 – 08:30 – Our friendly Cozy Bay Grand tour guide picks you up from your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter or Hanoi Opera House08:45 – Departure to Ha Long Bay via the modern expressway.10:15 – Short break (20–30 minutes) to refresh. 11:45 – 12:00 – Arrive at Tuan Chau Harbor, check-in at Cozy Bay Grand Cruise Lounge.12:30 – Welcome aboard! Enjoy a refreshing welcome drink, cruise briefing, and cabin check-in.
13:00: – Delight in a Buffet lunch while cruising through the stunning limestone landscapes of Ha Long Bay.
Afternoon Adventures: 14:30 – Visit Titov Island: 16:00 – Visit Luon Cave Visit Luon Cave by bamboo boat or kayak, gliding through calm waters surrounded by majestic cliffs.
17:30: – Return to the cruise and unwind on the sundeck with breathtaking sunset views. 17:30 – 18:30 – Happy Hour – BUY 2 DRINKS, GET 1 FREE
 Evening Highlights
18:00 – Sunset Party and Cooking Class.: Enjoy wine and fresh fruits while taking part in the cooking demonstration. Our chef will show how to make Vietnamese fresh spring rolls, and you will have the chance to taste the dish you prepared yourself.
19:00 – Dinner: Enjoy a romantic dinner served at the restaurant while admiring the sparkling beauty of Ha Long Bay at night.
20:30 – After dinner:: After dinner, guests can relax on the sundeck and enjoy the peaceful night scenery of the bay. You may also join several complimentary evening activities such as watching the traditional cultural fashion show “Heritage Footsteps”, taking souvenir photos, night squid fishing, singing Karaoke, playing board games, and admiring the tranquil night view of the bay. Alternatively, guests can enjoy additional paid services such as massage treatments or drinks at the Sky Bar.
Note:: Music will be turned off after 22:30 to maintain a quiet atmosphere on the cruise
Overnight on Cozy Bay Grand
DAY 2: HALONG BAY – SUNG SOT CAVE – KAYAKING – HANOI (B/L): Morning activities:
06:00: – Wake up early to witness the peaceful sunrise over Ha Long Bay. 06:15 – Refresh your body with a relaxing Tai Chi session on the sundeck.
06:45: – Enjoy morning tea/coffee and a light buffet breakfast with scenic bay views. 07:40 – Visit Sung Sot Cave (Surprising Cave), the largest and most famous cave in Halong Bay, renowned for its impressive stalactites and stalagmites.
09:00: – Return to the cruise, freshen up, and pack your luggage.
09:30: – Check-out of the room. Please put your luggage outside your cabin and leave the room key at the reception desk. Our staff will transfer your luggage to the waiting area.
10:30: – Enjoy your early Buffet lunch onboard while sailing back to the harbor.
11:45: – Disembark at Tuan Chau Harbor. Farewell crew members.Thank you for using the service of Cozy Bay Grand 4*. We look forward to welcoming you again on our cruise. 12:15 – Transfer back to Hanoi via expressway.14:30 – Short stop on the way (20-30 minutes).16:00 – Arrive at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter. The trip ends. Good bye and see you on your next trips!

Morning: Between 8:00 and 8:30, our shuttle service (book in the next step with an additional fee) will pick you up from your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter and transport you to Halong Bay, a magnificent wonder of the world. 
11:30 - 12:00: : Upon arrival at Halong Bay, our friendly Hera Cruise staff will warmly welcome you in the waiting lounge located at Tuan Chau Marina (No. 12). From there, your extraordinary experience aboard the luxurious Hera Grand Cruise in Halong Bay will begin. Prepare to be mesmerized by the spectacular landscape adorned with sparkling limestone islands. Lunch will be served in the lavish onboard restaurant. You'll have some leisure time to relax in your cabin before embarking on an exciting afternoon excursion.
Afternoon: Prepare for a wonderful part of the day in Halong with some exciting activities. Head to Titop Island, a true paradise for beach activities, to hike to the island's summit, take a refreshing dip in the emerald waters, or simply bask in the sunshine on the beach. Titop Island is a true paradise for beach activities Next, we will embark on an exploration of Sung Sot Cave. This cave showcases unique rock formations that cannot be found anywhere else. As you make your way inside, you will climb stone steps, creating a thrilling experience that feels like stepping into the sky. Return on board, you can relax, then join the cooking class where you'll learn how to make a traditional Vietnamese dish called floating rice cake
Don't miss out on our Happy Hour promotion from 17: 30 to 18:30, let’s enjoy a special offer - Buy 2 drinks, Get 1 for FREE.
Evening: Savor your dinner on the sundeck if the weather permits or in the Lily Restaurant.  After dinner, you can partake in various evening activities such as massages (additional charges apply), a complimentary herbal foot bath, bamboo dancing, and fashion shows titled "Footsteps of Heritage," and enjoy drinks at the Sky Bar while taking in the breathtaking night view of the bay. Finally, you'll spend the night onboard the cruise, resting and rejuvenating after an eventful day.
Morning & Afternoon: Your day begins with a refreshing Tai Chi Class on the sundeck, welcoming the sunrise. A light breakfast awaits you in the dining room, offering a variety of delicious options.
Today, we will explore the majestic Luon Cave, an ideal spot for kayaking or enjoying a bamboo boat ride to admire its unique semi: dry terrain and imposing gate-like structure
9:30: Back on board, you can rest in your room, enjoy herbal foot baths prepared by our crew, sunbathe on the sun deck, and take photos of Halong Bay. Afterward, it's time to return to the cruise for the check-out process at . Please pack your belongings outside the cabin and leave the key at the reception desk.  A delectable buffet brunch will be served in the elegant restaurant, allowing you to savor your meal while taking in the breathtaking views of the magnificent Halong Bay.
11:00: We will arrive at Tuan Chau Port around . If you have utilized our transfer service, our driver will be waiting to take you back to your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter (book the transfer in the next step with an additional fee).

2 Days / 1 Night Cruises.title: Halong Bay 2 Days 1 Night Trip
2 Days / 1 Night Cruises.itinerary:
Halong Bay 2 Days 1 Night Trip
HALONG BAY 2 DAYS 1 NIGHT TRIP
Stay Overnight on a 5: Star Boutique CruiseExperience one of the most elegant cruises on Halong Bay with spacious cabins, private balconies, and premium amenities.
Discover Sung Sot Cave (Surprising Cave)Explore the largest and most magnificent cave in Halong Bay, filled with awe: inspiring stalactites and stalagmites.
Titop Island: Beach & ViewpointSwim in emerald waters or hike to the top of the island for a spectacular panoramic view of Halong Bay.
Kayaking or Bamboo Boat Ride at Luon CaveGlide through a peaceful lagoon surrounded by towering limestone cliffs: perfect for nature lovers. Sunset Party on the SundeckEnjoy fresh fruit, snacks, and drinks while watching the sun set over the bay in a truly magical atmosphere. Gourmet Cuisine OnboardSavor a mix of Vietnamese and international dishes with buffet brunches, set menus, and a special dinner. Evening Activities & EntertainmentTry squid fishing, enjoy karaoke, cooking class, play board games, or relax under the stars with the gentle rocking of the bay.
DAY 1: HANOI – TUAN CHAU PORT – LUON CAVE – TITOP BEACH ISLAND (Lunch, Dinner)
08: 00 – 08:45: Begin your journey with a convenient pick-up from your hotel in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Embark on a picturesque drive to Halong Bay, pausing for a 30-minute break to stretch and refresh along the way.
11: 45: Arrive at the Tuan Chau International Cruise Port and check in to the luxurious Arcady Boutique Cruise. Savor a refreshing welcome drink as you await embarkation.
12: 30: Delight in a sumptuous buffet lunch as the cruise sets sail, gliding past the awe-inspiring limestone karsts that define the beauty of Halong Bay.
14: 00: Luon cave excursion on bamboo rowing boat by locals or kayaking. This is one of the must-do activities in the bay
15: 30: Embark on an excursion to Titop Island, where you can revel in the crystal-clear emerald waters with a refreshing swim or ascend to the island’s summit for breathtaking panoramic views of the bay.
17: 00: Return to the cruise to enjoy a captivating Sunset Party on the sundeck. Participate in a delightful cooking class where you’ll learn to prepare traditional Vietnamese dishes.
18: 30: Indulge in a lavish dinner served onboard.
20: 00 – 22:00: Unwind with a variety of evening activities, including board games, karaoke, or squid fishing. Conclude your day with a restful overnight stay in your elegantly appointed luxury cabin.  
DAY 2: SUNG SOT CAVE – TUAN CHAU PORT – HANOI (Breakfast, Brunch)
06: 30: Begin your day early, immersing yourself in the tranquil beauty of Halong Bay’s morning. Delight in a light breakfast served on board.
07: 30: Discover the wonders of Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave, one of the largest and most magnificent caves in Halong Bay.
09: 00: Return to the cruise and indulge in a sumptuous buffet brunch as the vessel gracefully makes its way back to the harbor.
10: 30: Complete the check-out process and disembark at Tuan Chau Port, bidding farewell to the enchanting bay.
12: 00: Board the bus for your return journey to Hanoi, reaching the capital city by late afternoon, leaving you with cherished memories of your adventure.  
Things to Bring for the Tour:: Important Note:Disposable plastic items are strictly prohibited in Ha Long Bay.Guests may be fined up to 15 million VND if found bringing them into the bay.
Children Policies:: Children under 5 years old sharing the full price cabin with adults (without extra bed): Children from 5 to 11 years old sharing the full price cabin with adults (without extra bed):
Children over 11 years old: charged 100% adult price
Cancellation Policies:
Cancellation for FIT bookings (Under 5 cabins): More than 14 days prior to actual arrival will be Free of Charge
7: 14 days prior to actual arrival will be charged 30% on the total booking value
4: 7 days prior to actual arrival will be charged 50% on the total booking value 72 hours prior to actual arrival will be charged at 100% on the total booking value
Cancellation for GIT bookings (From 6 cabin up): More than 21 days prior to actual arrival will be Free of Charge
14: 21 days prior to actual arrival will be charge 50% on the total booking value
No: Show or 0-14 days prior to actual arrival will be charge 100% on the total booking value
Cancellation due to Bad – Weather: If the cancellation be announced by the Management Board of Halong Bay, depend on the timing of the cancellation, following policies will be applied:
Before departure from Hanoi to Halong Bay (none of the services has been used): 100% refund.
During the trip (some services have been used: transfer, lunch, etc.): used services will be charged, the rest will be refunded. The trip will be cut down from 2 nights to 1 night, tourists will be charged as 2 days/ 1 night trip, plus other used services, the rest will be refunded. The final cost will be confirmed by your consultant via email. In all cases, please contact us directly for any urgent help. We are here to support you with all of our best!

2 Days / 1 Night Cruises.title: Grand Pioneers 6 Star Cruise Ha Long Bay 2D1N
2 Days / 1 Night Cruises.itinerary:
THE WORL HERITAGE DISCOVERY HALONG BAY
DAY 1: Hanoi – Tuan Chau Marina – Halong Bay – Sung sot Cave
08:15 – 08:45:  Our driver will pick you up from your hotel in the Old Quarter or at our cruise waiting lounge (if you have booked the shuttle with us). The journey time to Halong Bay takes approximately 2.5 hours.
09:50:  A short break on route for refreshments (15 minutes).
11:30 – 11:45: You will be presented at Tuan Chau International Port (Navigation: ), where Grand Pioneers Cruise staff will welcome and assist with check-in procedures.
12:30: You will check in at the Reception, on the first floor.
13:00 – 14:30: Enjoy our welcome drink and be introduced about the itinerary and safety policies. Lunch will be served in the Dining By The Bay restaurant.
15:30 – 16:30: The transfer boat and the team of Grand Pioneers Cruise staff will take you to the Sung Sot Cave, one of the most beautiful caves in Halong Bay, discovered by a group of French explorers in 1901. *For the guest who do not get involved in experience activities.
You can enjoy our services on the cruise including spa & massage, 4: season pool, cigar & lounge, kid clubs, ect.
17:30 – 18:30: Enjoy the best moments of the day as the sun hits the water between the dramatic limestone peaks and emerald-green coves, choose and savor Canapé and your favorite drink offerings at the Sky bar.
19:00: Tantalize your taste buds with a selection of Western and Vietnamese cuisine.
21:00: After dinner, chill out in your suite; pamper yourself at spa; experience squid fishing back of the boat on the first floor; or spend time with your fellow companions at our cigar and wine lounge, karaoke club, skybar or the pool bar.
Overnight on the Grand Pioneers Cruise. *Some activities may incur an additional charge: see the exclusions.  
Day 2: Halong Bay – Sung Sot Cave – Hanoi
05: 30 – 06:00 Enjoy the magnificent sunrise across Heritage Bay, immerse yourself in the sound of waves and be ready for a chill and fresh day.06:00 – 6:30 Start the day on our Grand Pioneers Cruise with a Tai Chi session on the sundeck or a work-out in the gym; or you may just want to sleep in.
06: 30 – 07:30 A light breakfast will be served in the restaurant.
07: 30 – 08:30 Our speed boat will transport you to Luon Cave – a best destination for visiting by rowing bamboo boat, located on the north-eastern part of Bo Hon Island.
09: 30 – 10:30 Check out at our Reception Desk on the first floor. Enjoy the brunch buffet on the cruise while continuing the journey back to the port.
10: 45 Cruise back to the Grand Pioneers Cruise port.
11: 00 Arrive back in Hanoi approximately 14:30 – 14:45.  
NOTE: Wifi connection: at times due to the remote location the signal may be weak. We hope for your kind understanding as the cruise is far from the mainland. Advance registration is required. Please provide your full name, date of birth, nationality, gender, passport number and visa expiry date. A valid passport is required upon check-in, otherwise boarding may be denied by the port authority. ITINERARY The above is an outline itinerary and specific timing and more detail will be given by the tourguide during the trip. Please note itineraries in the Ha Long Bay region are subject to change without prior notice depending on weather conditions, tidal levels, and local authority regulations. All meals are included on board. Please advise If you have any special dietary requirementsor food allergies when you book or at least 24 hours before departure.

3 DAYS 2 NIGHT ON CRUISE
DETAIL  ITINERARY :
DAY 1: HANOI – HALONG BAY – SUPPRISING CAVE  – TITOP ISLAND (L/ D)
 8h10-8h30::  Tour guide  will pick you up at your hotel in Ha Noi Old Quarter.  Have a short break on half way for 20 minutes to relax and happy room.
12h00::  Arrive to Tuan Chau Harbor.
12h30::  Welcome on board Enjoy welcome to drink and get a brief introduction about cruise and safety guidelines. Check- in your cabin.
13h00::  Enjoy your  lunch with Vietnamese traditional dishes, while cruising in the magnificent Halong Bay, admiring the fascinating rock formations in the bay.
14h30::  Visiting Sung Sot Cave (Surprising cave).
15h30::  Our cruise will take you to the Titop Island  it is noted for having a viewpoint at its peak which affords splendid views all around Halong Bay and  enjoy your swimming  on the beach.
17h00::  Come back Cruise then take a shower, Relax on sundeck, sunset watching in comfortable lounge chairs while drinking a cocktail or reading a book in the most magical moment.
18h00::  welcome Sunset Party  and Cooking Class  How to make fresh spring roll then enjoy your own made
19h00::  Dinner is ready serve in the restaurant in middle of romantic Bay
After dinner::  Join activities : fishing, karaoke singing, drinking , or Relax on sundeck
Overnight on boat: Share cabin available base on twin or triple.
DAY 2: TRANSFER DAY CRUISE  (B/ L, D)
7h:00: : Have brekfast in restaurant
08:30:   Pick up at cruises and depart from Titop area in Ha Long bay
10:30:   Transfer to Lan Ha bay which is formed by the archipelago Cat Ba island. Stop at Dark and Bright caves area for kayaking in an hour and a half
11:30:  Lunch will be served on boat
12:30 :  Move to Ba Trai Dao beaches (Three Peaches Beaches) for swimming in the crystal water and in a beautiful white sandy beach for an hour and fifteen minutes.
13:30:   Boat return to Ha Long bay to explore more land-scape
14:45:  Stop forty minutes at Pearl Farm Exhibition Center and Museum for learning how to raise the farm, harvest pearls and its business
15:30 :   Back to the boat and transfer to the overnight cruises at Titop area. Bid farewell the day boat crew

6h00::  Wake up in the early morning enjoy great moument in fresh air
7h00::  Have  Breakfast 8h00: Boat cruising to Luon Cave Luon Cave is located on Bo Hon Island, Luon Cave has the shape of an arc with 60 meters in length and 2.5 – 4 in height depending on the tide. Because of the limited height, the only way to visit Luon Cave is by a small boat or a kayak.
10h00::  Check-out and enjoy a fantastic cruise on the bay.
1100::  Enjoy the lunch while Cruising back to Tuan Chau Harbour.
12h00::  Arrive harbor ,say goodbye honest crew on board. Get on the bus head back to Hanoi or go to Ninh Binh
16h00::  Arrive at the hotel in Ha Noi Old Quarter. Trip ends !

07:30-08:00: You will be picked up at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter and transferred to Ha Long (For guests booking Limousine Bus or shuttle bus only).
11:30-12:00: Upon arrival at No 12, Tuan Chau Marina, you will enjoy a warm welcome by our cruise staff in the waiting lounge and complete the check-in procedure.
12:00: Upon boarding Hera Grand Luxury Cruise, our crew welcomes you with a refreshing drink and cold towel before checking into your cabin. Enjoy your lunch at our luxurious restaurant on board while the vessel cruises toward Sung Sot Cave and Titop Island.
14:30: Return to your room and prepare for swimming activities at Titop Island. Visit Titop Island and hike to the top for stunning views of Ha Long Bay, or swim in the clear blue water.
16:00: Hera Cruise will take you to visit Sung Sot Cave, the largest and most magnificent cave in Halong Bay, known for its impressive stalactites and stalagmites.
17:30-18:00: Back on board, you will participate in a Sunset party & cooking class while the vessel cruises toward the shore. You can enjoy relaxing moments while sipping a cup of traditional Vietnamese tea or coffee on the sundeck amid wonderful scenery and a beautiful sunset. Ha Long Bay is calm during the day, but when the sun goes down, the Bay becomes even more tranquil and peaceful. You will be instructed to make delicious traditional Vietnamese floating rice cake by our chef and then enjoy the floating rice cake made on your own.
17:30-18:30: Happy hour – BUY 2 DRINKS GET 1 FOR FREE
19:30: Outdoor dinner. Enjoy a romantic dinner outdoors (if the weather is favorable) or restaurant
21:30: After dinner, you will enjoy a peaceful view of the Bay at night on the deck. You can also participate in evening activities such as massage (subject to additional charge), herbal foot bath in your room (free of charge), Bamboo dancing, fashion show traditional customes “Footsteps of Heritage” and some drinks at Sky Bar while admiring breathtaking view of the Bay at night and squid fishing. The cruise anchors for your peaceful night stay in a quiet area.
06:15: Join a Tai Chi session on the sundeck.
06:30-07:00: Enjoy a light breakfast with tea, coffee, pastries, and fresh fruits.
08:30: A day boat picks up guests for the second day’s journey.
08:45: Visit Trinh Nữ Cave, a legendary site in Halong Bay known for its fascinating love story and breathtaking scenery.
10:30: Continue the journey to Ba Trái Đào (Three Peaches) Beach, a beautiful area with white sandy beaches and turquoise waters. Enjoy free time for swimming, sunbathing, or relaxing on the beach.
12:00: Enjoy lunch on the day boat.
14:00: Visit a Pearl Farm, explore the Exhibition Center & Pearl Museum, and learn about pearl cultivation and processing.
15:30: Return to the Hera Cruise to continue the journey.
15:30:               Back to Hera Grand Luxury Cruise, you can take a rest or relax on the Sundeck and take some nice pictures of Halong Bay. You can also use the foot soak basin and sauna room for free or enjoy a massage (subject to an additional charge). 17.30-18.00     Back on board, you will join the Sunset party & cooking class while the ship heads towards shore. Guests can enjoy relaxing moments while drinking a cup of traditional Vietnamese tea or coffee on the sun deck amidst wonderful views and beautiful sunsets. Halong Bay is quiet during the day, but when the sun goes down, the Bay becomes even quieter and more peaceful. You will be instructed by our chef to make traditional Vietnamese drift cakes and then enjoy your drift cakes. 17.30-18.30     Happy Hour – BUY 2 DRINKS GET 1 FREE
19:30   Gala Dinner: . Enjoy your dinner on the sun deck (if the weather is favorable) or at Lily’s Restaurant
21:30              : After dinner, enjoy peaceful views of the Bay at night on the deck.  Guests can also enjoy evening activities such as massage (surcharge), herbal foot bath in room (free), or enjoy music and some drinks at the Sky Bar while admiring breathtaking views of the Bay at night and squid fishing.
The ship anchors at the designated area for overnight stay
06:15:: Join a Tai Chi session on the sundeck.

3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.title: Sea Stars Cruise -2 Days 1 Night
3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.itinerary:
11:30-12:00
Arrive at the Sea Stars Lounge (2nd floor: Halong International Cruise Port) for check-in procedures for your 2-day 1-night Sea Stars Cruise in Halong Bay.
12:15-12:30: Board the Sea Stars Cruise and enjoy a welcome drink while the cruise manager introduces you to the unique itinerary, crossing both Bai Tu Long Bay and Halong Bay, along with safety regulations.
12:45-14:00: Enjoy a buffet lunch at the restaurant on the 2nd floor when the cruise sails past thousands of limestone islands such as Am Tich islet & Mat Quy islet. Relax and admire scenery of this World Natural Heritage site.
14:30-15:30: Visit Surprise Cave, the most beautiful and largest cave in Halong Bay, featuring an impressive system of stalactites and stalagmites formed over 1000 years.
15:45-16:45: Arrive at Titop Island, where you can swim in the sea, and enjoy the cool water of the ocean and white sand beach. You can hike to the mountain peak for a panoramic view of Halong Bay.
17:00-18:00: Moves to the overnight anchorage at Lom Bo. Enjoy Sunset Hour with a drink offer “Buy One, Get One Free” and complimentary snacks on the sundeck. Behold the beautiful sunset descending over the magnificent bay.
Then, participate in our cooking class starting at 5: 30 PM to make traditional Vietnamese food with guidance.
19:00-20:30: Eat dinner at the restaurant on the 2nd floor.
20:30-22:30: After dinner, enjoy free time amidst the peaceful ocean scene. Take part in complimentary experiences like squid fishing, or relax with spa services (surcharge). To use the karaoke room located on the lower deck, please contact the management to make reservations in advance (surcharge). Premium imported wines and spirits are available to enjoy under the night sky of Halong Bay.
6:15-6:45
Start the new day of your 2: day Halong Bay tour with Tai Chi exercises on the sundeck or use high-quality gym equipment on the 1st floor.
7:00-7:45: Served buffet breakfast at the restaurant on the 2nd floor.
8:00-9:00: Visit the Pearl Farm in Tung Sau. Explore the pearl display room, and learn about pearl farming, care, and harvesting activities. Guests can also enjoy complimentary kayaking experiences.
9:00-9:30: Back to the cruise to check out, and settle bills at the reception desk.
10:00-11:00: Enjoy brunch at the restaurant on the 2nd floor while returning to the Halong International Cruise Port.
11:00-11:15: Disembark the cruise, marking the end of your overnight Halong Bay cruise services. Note
The itinerary can be changed due to weather conditions or tides without prior notice. Wi: Fi is available throughout the cruise areas; however, internet connection may be unstable in some areas within the bay.
For those seeking a longer adventure, consider our 3: day 2-night Sea Stars Cruise in Halong Bay, offered through Asia Links Travel as your accompany Vietnam travel agency. This extended itinerary allows for even more exploration and enjoyment of this stunning World Natural Heritage site. What’s included

Notes For Guests Attractions in Lan Ha Bay day tour from Hanoi, Hai Phong, Cat Ba Island 1. Visit Lan Ha Bay Lan Ha Bay Lan Ha Bay is located in the south of Ha Long Bay and east of Cat Ba Island, Lan Ha Bay has an area of ​​over 7,000 hectares with the spectacular beauty of about 400 large and small islands. Carrying in many interesting shapes, unlike Ha Long Bay, all the islands in Lan Ha Bay are covered with greenery, even if they are only extremely small islands. 2. Visit Cai Beo ancient fishing village Cai Beo ancient fishing village 3. Ba Trai Dao Beach Area The local residents of Halong Bay now still tell the old story about the origination of Ba Trai Dao Islet. Story has it that the youngest daughter of the God fell in love with a poor fisherman. As she wanted him to be immortal to be with her forever, she stole three peaches in the heaven for him. The God noticed and was very angry. He turned three peaches into three stone mountains on the sea. Therefore, the locals named the islet as “Ba Trai Dao” Islet (Three Peaches Islet). Ba Trai Dao Beach area 4. Rua Islet Rua islet
Rua Islet. Photo: Bui Hong Thang It is a small islet situated in Lan Ha Bay with the shape of a swimming turtle. You can see it on the way from Beo port to Viet Hai village. 5. Chuong Islet Chuong islet Chuong Islet is also known as But (Pen), Nen (Candle), Bap Chuoi (Banana flower spike). You can see it on the way from the town of Cat Ba to Cua Van fishing village. 6. Dark and Bright Cave Dark and Bright cave The Dark Cave is the long and dark one, which will require a torch to be handed for visitors beforehand. In contrast, the Bright Cave is short, and you can see the other bright side from this side. Exploring Dark and Bright cave, the best way is doing kayaking and swimming through the tunnel. While the Bright Cave is always available, the Dark Cave can be swallowed by the tide and difficult to pass through. Surely, you will surprise with amazing limestone islets and mountain in this area. Controlling your kayak and explore each corner of Dark and Bright cave by your style.
There are Benjamin fig trees shade the landscape and many orchids hang their sweet: scented flowers. In the lake, many species abound: shrimp, fish, crab and cuttle-fish.
Inside the grotto, the lake is surrounded by mountains. On the cliff one still find traces of fossils of fresh: water snails, which prove that men used to live there and this must have been a deep valley then.

Serenity Premium Cruise | Lan Ha Bay day tour The tour guide then provides key information about the cruise, itineraries, and other notes. 9:10 The trip starts! Our captain steers the cruise slowly, and the poetic scenery of Cai Beo ancient fishing village constantly appears with floating houses lying along the mountainside.
You will be surprised at the peaceful beauty of this 7,000: year-old village. It’s time to learn more about the local fishers, their daily life, and the cultural values shared by our experienced guides.
The cruise moves further into the core of bay where you can’t help but be amazed by the gift of Mother Nature: a large bay area, the phenomenal emerald water embracing hundreds of rocky islands of various sizes and shapes. Cai Beo village We’ll enjoy a view of Ha Long Bay before we reach the kayaking area. If the weather is clear, you might even catch a glimpse of Ha Long City from the top deck.
10:30:  The boat anchors at DARK CAVE AND BRIGHT CAVE area ( Sang – Toi Cave). Located in the border region between Halong Bay and Lan Ha Bay,this is surely one of the best places for kayaking. Let’s spend one and a half hour doing kayaking to discover stunning limestone structure and interesting natural habitat there. “The subject can be changed due to of the sea currents, weather conditions and tide. It can be changed to visit Viet Hai Village & Cat Ba National Park in stead of Dark & Bright Cave” Biking Viet Hai Village

Our Captain and tour guide will choose the best stop for the group to experience interesting activities: swimming in the middle of the sea, boat jumping,… Ba Trai Dao Beach Area Swimming Lan Ha Bay 15:00 The cruise heads back to harbour by different route wehre you can keep admiring the romantic landscape of Lan Ha Bay. Lan Ha Bay

Notes For Guests Attractions in Lan Ha Bay day tour from Hanoi, Hai Phong, Cat Ba Island 1. Visit Lan Ha Bay Lan Ha Bay Lan Ha Bay is located in the south of Ha Long Bay and east of Cat Ba Island, Lan Ha Bay has an area of ​​over 7,000 hectares with the spectacular beauty of about 400 large and small islands. Carrying in many interesting shapes, unlike Ha Long Bay, all the islands in Lan Ha Bay are covered with greenery, even if they are only extremely small islands. 2. Visit Cai Beo ancient fishing village Cai Beo ancient fishing village 3. Ba Trai Dao Beach Area The local residents of Halong Bay now still tell the old story about the origination of Ba Trai Dao Islet. Story has it that the youngest daughter of the God fell in love with a poor fisherman. As she wanted him to be immortal to be with her forever, she stole three peaches in the heaven for him. The God noticed and was very angry. He turned three peaches into three stone mountains on the sea. Therefore, the locals named the islet as “Ba Trai Dao” Islet (Three Peaches Islet). Ba Trai Dao Beach area 4. Rua Islet Rua islet
Rua Islet. Photo: Bui Hong Thang It is a small islet situated in Lan Ha Bay with the shape of a swimming turtle. You can see it on the way from Beo port to Viet Hai village. 5. Chuong Islet Chuong islet Chuong Islet is also known as But (Pen), Nen (Candle), Bap Chuoi (Banana flower spike). You can see it on the way from the town of Cat Ba to Cua Van fishing village. 6. Dark and Bright Cave Dark and Bright cave The Dark Cave is the long and dark one, which will require a torch to be handed for visitors beforehand. In contrast, the Bright Cave is short, and you can see the other bright side from this side. Exploring Dark and Bright cave, the best way is doing kayaking and swimming through the tunnel. While the Bright Cave is always available, the Dark Cave can be swallowed by the tide and difficult to pass through. Surely, you will surprise with amazing limestone islets and mountain in this area. Controlling your kayak and explore each corner of Dark and Bright cave by your style.
There are Benjamin fig trees shade the landscape and many orchids hang their sweet: scented flowers. In the lake, many species abound: shrimp, fish, crab and cuttle-fish.
Inside the grotto, the lake is surrounded by mountains. On the cliff one still find traces of fossils of fresh: water snails, which prove that men used to live there and this must have been a deep valley then.
The beauty of the Dark and Bright cave  is the mingling of a number of factors: the mountain’s size and form, the color of the water and the clouds. BOOK NOW $50 $37/ Guest Your Name Email Phone Number Departure Date No. of Passengers

Visit Lan Ha Bay Lan Ha Bay Lan Ha Bay is located in the south of Ha Long Bay and east of Cat Ba Island, Lan Ha Bay has an area of ​​over 7,000 hectares with the spectacular beauty of about 400 large and small islands. Carrying in many interesting shapes, unlike Ha Long Bay, all the islands in Lan Ha Bay are covered with greenery, even if they are only extremely small islands. 2. Visit Cai Beo ancient fishing village Cai Beo ancient fishing village 3. Ba Trai Dao Beach Area The local residents of Halong Bay now still tell the old story about the origination of Ba Trai Dao Islet. Story has it that the youngest daughter of the God fell in love with a poor fisherman. As she wanted him to be immortal to be with her forever, she stole three peaches in the heaven for him. The God noticed and was very angry. He turned three peaches into three stone mountains on the sea. Therefore, the locals named the islet as “Ba Trai Dao” Islet (Three Peaches Islet). Ba Trai Dao Beach area 4. Rua Islet Rua islet
Rua Islet. Photo: Bui Hong Thang It is a small islet situated in Lan Ha Bay with the shape of a swimming turtle. You can see it on the way from Beo port to Viet Hai village. 5. Chuong Islet Chuong islet Chuong Islet is also known as But (Pen), Nen (Candle), Bap Chuoi (Banana flower spike). You can see it on the way from the town of Cat Ba to Cua Van fishing village. 6. Dark and Bright Cave Dark and Bright cave The Dark Cave is the long and dark one, which will require a torch to be handed for visitors beforehand. In contrast, the Bright Cave is short, and you can see the other bright side from this side. Exploring Dark and Bright cave, the best way is doing kayaking and swimming through the tunnel. While the Bright Cave is always available, the Dark Cave can be swallowed by the tide and difficult to pass through. Surely, you will surprise with amazing limestone islets and mountain in this area. Controlling your kayak and explore each corner of Dark and Bright cave by your style.

In Hai Phong, take the sea: crossing road from Tan Vu to Lach Huyen port, enjoying scenic views of Dinh Vu port. 10:15 – 10:30 Reach “CAT BA PEARL ISLAND“. Drive on a scenic road between the sea and the green mountains of Cat Ba National Park.
11:00:  Warmly welcome to SERENITY GRANDEUR CRUISES! While enjoying a welcome drink, our tour guide will provide key information about the cruise, itineraries, and other notes.
Our captain steers the cruise slowly, and the picturesque scenery of Cai Beo ancient fishing village constantly appears, with floating houses lining the mountainside. You will be surprised at the peaceful beauty of this 7,000: year-old village.
The cruise moves further into the core of the Bay, where you can’t help but be amazed by the gift of Mother Nature: a large bay area, the phenomenal emerald water embracing hundreds of rocky islands of various sizes and shapes.
11:30: Savor a delicious lunch (Buffet lunch is served for groups of 40 guests).
The cruise will continue through the East Gate and pass hundreds of unique rocky islands, and admire the unique turtle: shaped Hon Rua island.
13:00:  After lunch, the cruise sails to Viet Hai Port. Disembark and head to the pier, where you will take an electric car/ bicycle to the ancient Viet Hai Village.
Experience a unique fish: foot massage, stroll through well-preserved traditional houses, or engage in conversations with local residents for a truly memorable experience.
14:30 KAYAKING – SWIMMING: Our Captain and Tour Guide will select the best stop for the group to enjoy engaging activities, including swimming in the middle of the sea, jumping, sliding down from the top deck into the cool water, and kayaking. (We highly recommend that you wear a life jacket when swimming/ kayaking/playing with the water slide…for a safe journey)
15:30: The boat begins its journey back to Beo Pier. It is the perfect time to relax on the top deck with an ordered drink.
16:15: A Small sunset party is served with fresh fruit, biscuits & tea.
6:45 : 1Return to Beo Dock, say ”Goodbye” to Lan Ha Bay & Serenity Grandeur Cruise team, and Get on the bus back to Cat Ba Town or Hai Phong Cty or Hanoi.
20:30:  Arrive at Hanoi Old Quarter, end of an unforgettable journey.

Swimming in Halong Bay: Lan Ha Bay The bay is not only an ideal place for sunbathing with dazzling sunlight but also a beautiful beach with calm tides and clean and green water. 3. Then, just go along with us for an unforgettable Lan Ha Bay Sunset Party on Serenity Cruise. 4. Viet Hai Village cycling Cycling in Viet Hai village is an interesting experience. Along the way, our local guide will choose an old path once used by the villagers, allowing you to experience a part of the pristine beauty of Cat Ba National Park, ancient forests, and wartime tunnels built by the local people to connect the village to the bay. Discover the history behind this vital route with our knowledgeable guides during your visit. Cycling in Viet Hai village
What are the destinations on the Lan Ha Bay full: day cruise tour? 1. Visit Lan Ha Bay Lan Ha Bay Overview Lan Ha Bay is located in the south of Ha Long Bay and east of Cat Ba Island, Lan Ha Bay has an area of ​​over 7,000 hectares with the spectacular beauty of about 400 large and small islands. Carrying in many interesting shapes, unlike Ha Long Bay, all the islands in Lan Ha Bay are covered with greenery, even if they are only extremely small islands. 2. Visit Cai Beo ancient fishing village
Cai Beo Village: Cat Ba Island
3. Viet Hai village: Cat Ba Island Viet Hai village Cat Ba is a small village located far away in Cat Ba National Park, Hai Phong. Viet Hai Village is a community ecotourism destination suitable for travelers who love exploration.
Numerous visitors come here to feel their lungs inflate with the onrush of scenery: air, mountains, trees, and the locals. Fish massage If you have a chance to visit the village, you will experience one of the most unique types of village in North Vietnam. 4. Ba Trai Dao Beach area The local residents of Halong Bay now still tell the old story about the origination of Ba Trai Dao Islet. The story has it that the youngest daughter of God fell in love with a poor fisherman. As she wanted him to be immortal to be with her forever, she stole three peaches in heaven for him. The God noticed and was very angry. Ba Trai Dao Beach He turned three peaches into three stone mountains on the sea. Therefore, the locals named the islet “Ba Trai Dao” Islet (Three Peaches Islet).
5. Rua Islet: Lan Ha Bay Turtle Island It is a small islet situated in Lan Ha Bay with the shape of a swimming turtle. You can see it on the way from Beo port to Viet Hai village. ​​How to book?

Dora Cruise 2 Days 1 Night Level 3, Hai An Group building, No.25, Lane 1 Lam Ha street, Long Bien, Hanoi. DISCOVERY HALONG BAY – LAN HA BAY (2 DAYS 1 NIGHT) (Our itinerary is unique and different, we will take you to the less touristy and enchanted sceneries)
DAY 1: HANOI- HALONG – LAN HA ON DORA CRUISE ( L/ D)
08: 30 – 9:15: Our tour guide pick you up at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter. (if you use our limousine bus or private car)
09: 20: Departure to Halong Bay. You will have 1 short break during the way before arrive in Tuan Chau marina.
12: 00 – 12:15: Arrive to Tuan Chau harbor.
12: 30 – 13:15: Transferred by boat to Dora Cruise. Welcome to Dora Cruise and enjoy welcome drink, meet the captain, crew to get a brief introduction about cruise and safety guidelines. Check-in your cabin.
13: 15 – 13:30: Enjoy Vietnamese seafood and vegetarian lunch, while cruising in the magnificent Halong Bay, admiring the fascinating rock formations in the bay. – Continue cruising through Con Vit islet (Duck Islet), Thumb islet and Gia Luan Harbor where belonged to Cat Ba area.  – Discover lagoon natural area belonged to Lan Ha bay. Drop anchor for swimming or just simply sunbathe on our cruise (private, wild and fresh air). – Heading back toward the sleeping area – Do kayaking and swimming at Ba Trai Dao Islet or Tra Bau area where 
17.30: Come back to our Dora Cruise and participate in our sunset party with fruit, cake and wine. Take photos and relax
18: 00 – 18:15: Join cooking class guided directly by Chef of Dora Halong Cruise. You have chance to practice Vietnamese traditional dishes such as spring roll or famous cuisine of Vietnam
19: 15: Time for dinner enjoying special seafood and Vietnamese typical food on the cruise.
21: 00: Evening entertainments: play game on the cruise: cards game, chess, listen to music, squid fishing, relaxing and overnight on the Dora Cruise.
DAY 2: DORA LAN HA –  DARK & LIGHT CAVE – HA LONG CRUISE – HANOI ( B/L/D)
06.00: Early morning sun risers can enjoy Tai Chi lesson on sundeck.
07.15: Morning view of bay’s landscape with a cup of tea or coffee. Have breakfast.
8.15: You will be at reception to go visit Dark & Bright Cave by the tender (the transfer boat) to the small floating house and there you can have opportunity to explore the cave on local bamboo boat (rowing by the locals).
9: 30 – 10:15: Come back to Dora Cruise and check-out from the private cabin and enjoy a fantastic cruise on the bay.
10: 30: Have early lunch at the cruise before check out
11: 30: Dora Cruise are landing near Tuan Chau Harbor and transfer guest to Tuan Chau, say goodbye to Halong Bay and finish the cruise
12: 15: Return to gate 35, Tuan Chau marina and travel with our limousine bus to Hanoi Old Quarter
13: 50 – 14:00: Stopover in Hai Duong province to relax.
15: 30 – 16:00: Arrive in Hanoi
Notes: Cruise itinerary and schedule are subject to change without prior notice due to weather and operation conditions. 08: 00 – 08:30: Our driver will pick you up at your hotel in Hanoi old quarter (If you book our transfer service)
09: 00: Departure to Halong Bay for around 2.5 Hours with 20 minutes short break.
11: 30 – 12.00: Arrive Tuan Chau harbor 12:00 – 12:30 Get transfer to Doris Cruise by a tender boat.
Around 13: 00 Warmly welcome to Doris Cruise and enjoy Welcome drink, meet the captain, crew to get a brief introduction about cruise and safety guidelines. Enjoy the lunch while cruising in the magnificent Halong Bay, admiring the fascinating rock formations in the bay. – Continue cruising through Con Vit islet (Duck Islet), Thumb islet and Gia Luan Harbor were belonged to Lan Ha Bay. Check: in your cabin.

19.00: It is time for your romantic dinner
21.00: You are free for relaxing on cruise. Playing games, squid fishing, relaxing with massage service (on request) and stay overnight on the Doris Cruise.  
Day 02: Lan Ha Bay – Dark & Bright Cave – Ha Long Bay (Breakfast / Brunch)
06.30: Early morning sun risers and you can enjoy Tai-chi lesson on the sundeck.
07.00: 07.45: Have breakfast while cruising on the beautiful bay.
08.00: Mingling yourself in the stunning views of the Bay and its dramatic limestone islets as we sail through the calm emerald waters heading to Dark & Bright Cave. Take your option either exploring the cave yourself on kayak or comfortably on local bamboo boat rowed by the locals.
09.30: Check-out from the private cabin and enjoy a fantastic cruise on the bay.
10.00: Enjoy the brunch on the cruise with Vietnamese cuisine.
10.45: You will be transferred by tender to Tuan Chau Harbor.
11:30: Doris Cruise are landing Tuan Chau Harbor, tourist say goodbye to sailors and finish the cruise.
12:00 – 12:30: Return to Hanoi by the luxury limousine.

2 Days / 1 Night Cruises.itinerary:
Serenity Cruises: Halong Bay – Lan Ha Bay 2 days 1 night
Unique Halong Bay: Lan Ha Bay 2 Days 1 Night Tour
Unique Halong Bay – Lan Ha Bay 2-day 1-night: The tour with Serenity Cruises is the best choice for you.
Our cruises have a perfect combination of modernity & tradition in design, will not only bring you a journey in comfort & luxury but also take you deep into natural wonder with various interesting activities: kayaking, swimming, biking, etc.  If you are about to celebrate your honeymoon with your loved one, check out our exclusive HONEYMOON PACKAGE.
Two: day one-night cruise tour to less touristy area of Lan Ha & Ha Long Bay is an ideal trip for those who seek for truly experience. Check Availability Highlight INCLUSION & EXCLUSION
ITINERARY SERENITY CRUISES IN LAN HA: HALONG BAY
DAY 1 | HANOI: HALONG BAY – LAN HA BAY
8:20 – 8:45 | Pick-up time: For those who book our transfer service will be collected from hotels around Hanoi Old Quarter. Instead of spending 4 hours on the traditional road to Ha Long city, we will shortly arrive at Tuan Chau Wharf by express way after 2,5 hours driving.
11:30 – 12:00: Arrive in Tuan Chau Wharf – transfer by small boat to Serenity Cruises: She anchors far from crowded and touristy areas in the calm water surrounded by beautiful islets.
12:15 – 12:30 | Embark on Serenity Cruises: Warmly welcome to Serenity Cruises! While enjoying welcome drink, our cruise manager will deliver cruise briefing and safety introduction. After that you will check in your cabin.
13:00 | Enjoy fabulous lunch
Fabulous lunch is served while Serenity Cruises starts her sails into magnificent Lan Ha Bay: an extension of Ha Long Wonder which is much quieter and less touristy. She will pass famous Finger Islet, Frog Islet and thousands of uniquely shaped limestone towers and islands.
15:00 | Explore Lan Ha – Ha Long bay, hit the green emerald water for kayaking or swimming (if the weather permits)
Option 1: Serenity Cruises reaches Dau Be Island, one of the most beautiful islands located in the South East of Halong bay. It is time to discover Halong bay yourselves with your travel buddy on sharing kayak. Go explore the beauty of nature in hidden lagoon with lots of stalactites hanging down from the cave ceiling. This activity might depend on the tide level of the bay. In case the tide level is too high or too low, we will do kayaking in Dark Cave, Bright Cave area. There is a stop for those who wish to swim and go snorkeling in the lush green water.
Option 2: In the days of too high tide (usually seasonal), Serenity Cruises will take you to visit the giant fish and the floating village. We will do kayaking in the water body that embraces one of the most beautiful floating villages of the bay. While kayaking, you will have opportunities to learn more about another typical value of the region: the daily life of local fishermen. You will also have a brief look at the geology of the karst mountains that beautify the surroundings. Our cruise manager/tour guide will inform you which option we will follow based on their experience and weather conditions.
17:00 | Cooking demonstration: Back to Serenity Cruises and relax on cruise. Enjoy our Happy Hour Deal in all bars on cruise. On board, you may join a traditional cooking class presented by our crew. Before dinner, our experienced captain will choose the most tranquil area to anchor for overnight.
19:00 | Savor deluxe Dinner Set Menu: After the incredible dinner, take your leisure time to chat at the bar, watching movies in the restaurant, enjoy Spa treatment.You will stay overnight on cruise.
DAY 2 | LAN HA BAY – VIET HAI CAT BA – HANOI
6:00 | Sunrise Tai-chi/Yoga session sundeck
Be an early bird for photo hunt and join our Tai: chi session on the sundeck to refresh your body and mind.
6:30 | Have light breakfast: Serenity Cruises continues her sail to Cat Ba Island, passing amazing karst towers. Tea, coffee and a light breakfast is served with fresh air and peaceful surroundings.
7:15 | Visit Viet Hai village: Our crew will take you to Viet Hai, a small village located in the midst of jungles, covered by high mountains range of Cat Ba National Park. Spending around 30 minutes for biking along, you will feel the peaceful atmosphere, charming scenery of a typical village in the North of Vietnam.
9:15 | Return to Serenity Cruises
You will have some time for fresh relax on the cruise then spend a few minutes to settle your bill and check out from 9.15: 10.00 am.
10:00 | Taste delightful lunch: During the time well prepared lunch is served, Serenity Cruises slowly navigates emerald water and thousands of karst mountains towards the Harbour.
12:15 – 12:45 | Disembark Serenity Cruises and farewell the crew
13:00 – 13:15 | Travel back to Hanoi by bus: Bus transfer service from Halong to Hanoi is available for booking in advance.
15:30 | Arrive at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter, end of unforgettable trip: Important Notes Inclusion Exclusion WHY BOOKING DIRECTLY WITH US? Booking directly with Serenity Cruises guarantees that you’ll receive the best service and a personal touch. Here are some of the benefits: Before departure date, customers booking with us will be on the top list of free upgrading if the higher ranked cabin is available. We provide our direct customers with clear information on any aspect of your booking regarding price, inclusions, exclusions, promotions, free transfer, etc.

Option 1: Serenity Cruises reaches Dau Be Island, one of the most beautiful islands located in the South East of Halong bay. 2 Days / 1 Night Cruises.itinerary:
Velar Of The Seas Cruise
Discovery Halong bay: Lan Ha bay 2days/ 1night
2 DAYS: 1 NIGHT ON BOAT DAY 1
11:45 : Arrive at Tuan Chau Harbor. 12:15-13:00 Transfer by tender boat to Velar of the seas cruise
13:15: Enjoy a fabulous lunch in our restaurant. During lunch time, our cruise starts to sail through the magnificent Lan Ha Bay, a geological extension of Halong Bay which is less visited, less inhabited and therefore has the extra appeal of being a more peaceful place. After lunchtime, you will have a short break before joining the ﬁrst activity of the tour.
14:15 – 15:30: Mingling yourself in the stunning views of the Bay and its dramatic limestone islets as we sail through the calm emerald waters heading to Dark & Bright Cave. Take your option either exploring the cave yourself on kayak or comfortably on local bamboo boat rowed by the locals. 17:00-17:30 It’s time to join in swimming activity on the sea at Tra Bau area. or relaxing in the swimming pool on the 1st deck.
17:45 : Enjoy the Sunset Party with fruits and snacks at Velar Sky Bar and Happy Hour will offer you a drink at an attractive price. Happy together, watching the Sun falling into the sea will be unforgettable memories for every single traveler on board.
18:00 : Our Vietnamese cooking demonstration is a great way to learn how to prepare delicious appetizers and we will guide you through the process.
19:15 : You can spoil yourself with a unique Signature Dinner in our distinctive restaurant.
20:30 – 10:30: It is now time to relax with an exotic cocktail and drink in the evening landscape. Our bar offers a wide range of wine, beer, and liqueurs and is always a welcome sight for guests after a day sailing on the Bay. You can order an indulgent spa service, go squid ﬁshing or simply relax on our rooftop deck under the cover of a brightly illuminated sky.                           DAY 2
06:00 – 06:30: Greets ﬁrst light of the day on Sundeck, warming up your body with Tai Chi lesson or enjoy an early morning cup of tea, coffee or juice to watch the stunning scenery unfold before you
06:15 – 07:30: Light breakfast will be served in our restaurant (pastries, tea, coffee)
7:20 – 08:00: Discover and explore “Nha Be Hai Phong” 09:00 – 09:30 Please pack and arrange all your luggage for check-out, placing it outside your room by 9:00 AM so our staff can collect it. You can return your room key and settle any outstanding bills.
09:30-10:20: Brunch will be served in the Restaurant on the 4th floor while we cruise gently back to the harbor.
10:30: We will take the tender to return to the dock
11:15: We arrive in Tuan Chau Marina
INCLUDED:: • 1 night in Velar of the seas cruise• 04 meals included: 01 Breakfast and 2 lunches + 1 dinner• Complimentary mineral water onboard (01 bottle/pax/day)• Sightseeing fees. • Onboard insurance and service charges.• Kayaking
EXCLUDED:: • Transfers to and from Halong Bay, VISA service …• Airfare, Visa,• Beverages, spa and personal expenses.• VAT• All services not clearly mentioned
CHILDREN POLICY: • Free for under 6 year- old children sharing with their parent, only one child one cabin, second child will be charge 50%. • Charge 75% for the children from 6 to 9 year- old sharing with their parent. • Full charge for the children at 10 year-old and above.
* NOTE:: • Cruise itinerary and schedule are subject to change due to weather, tide levels and operating conditions without prior notice.• Swimming or kayaking excursions may be cancelled due to poor weather. • Meals on board are fusion: Vietnamese, seafood & international. Guests should advise of any specialfood preferences, allergies or dietary requirements at least one (01) week prior to the cruise date. • Advance registration is required prior to departure at least 3 days with your full name, date of birth,nationality, gender, passport number and visa expiration date for all passengers. A valid passport isrequired upon check-in. Otherwise, boarding may be denied by port authority. • Wi-Fi is available onboard free of charge. However, regular interruption is expected due to nature ofinternet signal at sea. Booking

2 DAYS: 1 NIGHT ON BOAT DAY 1
11:45 : Arrive at Tuan Chau Harbor. 12:15-13:00 Transfer by tender boat to Velar of the seas cruise
13:15: Enjoy a fabulous lunch in our restaurant. During lunch time, our cruise starts to sail through the magnificent Lan Ha Bay, a geological extension of Halong Bay which is less visited, less inhabited and therefore has the extra appeal of being a more peaceful place. After lunchtime, you will have a short break before joining the ﬁrst activity of the tour.
14:15 – 15:30: Mingling yourself in the stunning views of the Bay and its dramatic limestone islets as we sail through the calm emerald waters heading to Dark & Bright Cave. Take your option either exploring the cave yourself on kayak or comfortably on local bamboo boat rowed by the locals. 17:00-17:30 It’s time to join in swimming activity on the sea at Tra Bau area. or relaxing in the swimming pool on the 1st deck.
17:45 : Enjoy the Sunset Party with fruits and snacks at Velar Sky Bar and Happy Hour will offer you a drink at an attractive price. Happy together, watching the Sun falling into the sea will be unforgettable memories for every single traveler on board.
18:00 : Our Vietnamese cooking demonstration is a great way to learn how to prepare delicious appetizers and we will guide you through the process.
19:15 : You can spoil yourself with a unique Signature Dinner in our distinctive restaurant.
20:30 – 10:30: It is now time to relax with an exotic cocktail and drink in the evening landscape. Our bar offers a wide range of wine, beer, and liqueurs and is always a welcome sight for guests after a day sailing on the Bay. You can order an indulgent spa service, go squid ﬁshing or simply relax on our rooftop deck under the cover of a brightly illuminated sky.                           DAY 2
06:00 – 06:30: Greets ﬁrst light of the day on Sundeck, warming up your body with Tai Chi lesson or enjoy an early morning cup of tea, coffee or juice to watch the stunning scenery unfold before you
06:15 – 07:30: Light breakfast will be served in our restaurant (pastries, tea, coffee)
7:20 – 08:00: Discover and explore “Nha Be Hai Phong” 09:00 – 09:30 Please pack and arrange all your luggage for check-out, placing it outside your room by 9:00 AM so our staff can collect it. You can return your room key and settle any outstanding bills.
09:30-10:20: Brunch will be served in the Restaurant on the 4th floor while we cruise gently back to the harbor.
10:30: We will take the tender to return to the dock
11:15: We arrive in Tuan Chau Marina

DAY 1: TUAN CHAU PORT – LAN HA BAY – BA TRAI DAO BEACH (L/D)
08: 20 – 08:50. Pick up at your hotel lobby in Hanoi Old Quarter (If you book our limousine bus/ regular private car)
12: 15 – 12:30. Arrive at the waiting lounge for check-in. A transfer boat will take you to the Tulip Cruise
13: 00 – 13:30. Board Tulip Cruise at Finger Islet. Enjoy a welcome drink, safety briefing, and check-in, followed by a delightful lunch while admiring iconic rock formations such as Turtle Islet and Man Head Islet
15: 00. Arrive the peaceful area for swimming or Kayaking at the peaceful & beautiful Lan Ha bay. You will join the guide to kayak around the wonderful wide nature, clean water. There is a beautiful small beach named Three Peaches (Ba Trai Dao beach) as the special shaped limestone mountains surrounding 17:00 – 17:15. Return to Tulip Cruise for swimming and kayaking near the cruise  
17: 45. Enjoy sunset party with fresh fruits, cakes, tea and watch the sunset.
16: 00. Join a cooking class with cruise’s chef  
19: 15. Having Fine Dining dinner at the restaurant 
20: 30 – 22:00. Evening entertainments: play game on the cruise: cards game, chess, listen to music, squid fishing, relaxing and overnight on the Tulip Cruise
DAY 2: TULIP LAN HA – VIET HAI VILLAGE – HA LONG CRUISE – HANOI ( B/L) 06:00 – 06:30: Begin the day with a Tai Chi session on the sundeck 
06: 45 – 07:30: Morning view of bay’s landscape with a cup of tea or coffee. Have light breakfast
07: 45 – 08:00: Visit Viet Hai Village by bicycle or electric car to explore the peaceful local life or stay on boat to enjoy mini golf or do swimming and kayaking on the bay You can stay on the cruise for relaxing
10: 00: Return to Tulip Cruise and check out
10: 30: Enjoy the lunch on board 
11: 45: Say goodbye to the crew and get on the transfer boat back Tuan Chau Harbor
12: 15: Come back to Tuan Chau Harbor 
15: 30 – 16:00: Transfer back to Hanoi

3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.title: Premium Cruise 3 Days 2 Night Cruise Lan Ha Bay
3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.itinerary:
A fantastic journey that covers most of the attractions in Lan Ha Bay and is well: organized. The tour allows you to explore famous sights comfortably. Sunlight Cruise turns ordinary experiences into extraordinary ones! HIGHLIGHTS & ADVICE:
DAY 1: HANOI – CAT BA – LAN HA BAY – LUNCH – KAYAKING VISIT TAI KEO LAGOON – DINNER – FISHING/KARAOKE (L, D):  
DAY 2: BREAKFAST – DARK AND BRIGHT CAVE – BACK CRUISE (B,L,D)
06: 00 Waking up enjoying beautiful moments when a blazing sunrise breaks the clouds of the island on the bay (accept winter time have no sunrise)
08: 00 Your breakfast will be ready in quite bay.
9: 00: Transfer to small boat to Dark and Bright cave area next to Halong Bay area, doing kayaking by your own through Dark and Bright cave explore Have lunch on local tender boat with local food serve then boat moving to other area for enjoy swimming
15: 00 Back to Sleeping boat for your 2nd night stay
19: 00 Dinner is served in the restaurant. Enjoy delicious local food prepared and served for you by our wonderful onboard catering staff.
20: 00 Happy hour free fresh local beer onboard with group. Overnight on boat Please be aware that the itinerary is subject to change due to weather conditions, which may necessitate adjustments by the organizing team to ensure the safety and enjoyment of the tour.
DAY 3 LAN HA – BIKING TO VIET HAI VILLAGE  - HANOI (B,L): 06.00 Waking up enjoying beautiful moments when a blazing sunrise breaks the clouds of the island on the bay (accept winter time have no sunrise)
07: 00: Have breakfast in restaurant , after moving to Viet Hai harbour for biking to the Village passing 5km. It is a wonderful place to ride a bike around for a half hour. The scenery is very pretty
11: 00 Lunch is served on boat, have good meal
12: 00 Disembark at to Beo Harbor. Get on the bus back to Hanoi, say goodbye Amazing Lan Ha Bay and Cat Ba Island
16: 00 Back to Hanoi. Tour guide will drop you back at your hotel
Note: Due to weather, our itinerary may change to ensure guest safety and comfort. We adjust our route to avoid bad conditions, offering alternative beautiful destinations. Our experienced crew ensures a memorable journey, navigating smoothly regardless of the weather.

3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.title: Premium Cruise 3 Days 2 Night Cruise Lan Ha Bay And Cat Ba Island Hotel/ Bungalow
3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.itinerary:
3D2N (1N HOTEL + 1N ON CRUISE )
A fantastic journey covers most of the attractions in Lan Ha Bay and is well: organized. The tour takes you to explore beautifully famous sights in a comfortable way. Sunlight Cruises does ordinary things extraordinarily!
HIGHLIGHT: ADVICE:
DAY 1: HANOI - CATBA NATIONAL PARK- TRUNG TRANG  CAVE   ( L,D)
07:00:: Pick-up at hotels if located in the Hanoi Old Quarter by shuttle bus departing to Lan Ha Bay with stopovers for  refreshing en route.
12:000: : Arrive Hotel, check in and have lunch Afternoon: 14:00: Our local tour guide will take you to visit Cat Ba National Park  which is a tourist attraction to millions of domestic and oversea visitors. Coming to the Park, travelers not only could worship the beauty of landscapes, seascapes
16:00:: Keep moving to visit Trung Trang cave which has an ecosystem in mysterious darkness, home to many species of creatures such as bats, birds, insects and reptiles. The lighting system is very limited to preserve the characteristics of the ecological environment in the cave
17:00:: back to hotel and have dinner
Options:: Hotels:3,4 star, resorts
DAY 2: CATBA ISLAND HOTEL – LAN HA BAY  (B, L/D)
8:00:: Have Breakfast in Hotel , then have freetim walkig around  
12:00:: Our bus pick you up to  Beo Harbor, transfer by tender to Sunlight Cruise, and enjoy welcome drinks, receive cruise briefing, safety instructions then check in to your cabin
13:00:: A special lunch in Vietnamese cuisine of fresh seafood and an assortment of appetizing favorites are served while sailing through these islands
14:30:: The cruise sails through Lan Ha Bay and completes its entry through the Cua Van  Area. The area is surrounded by extraordinary karst landscapes. Explore bay by your own kayaking
16:30:: Enjoy Swimming in a nearby area, you can join jumping from the top of the boat into water
18:00:: Come back to cruise later to enjoy cooking class with fresh spring roll
19:00:: Dinner is served in the restaurant. Enjoy delicious local food prepared and served for you by our wonderful onboard catering staff. After dinner you can do squid fishing or singing karaoke
20:00-21:00: “: Happy hour” -  on Sundeck with group. Overnight on board
DAY 3: BIKING TO VIET HAI VILLAGE - HANOI  ( B/L).
06:00:: Waking up enjoying beautiful moments when a blazing sunrise breaks the clouds of the island on the bay (accept winter time have no sunrise)
07:00:: Your breakfast will be ready in quite a bay
08:00:: Start riding bicycle 5 km to Viet Hai Village , Viet Hai is a small village in the midst of jungles, covered by high mountains range of the Cat Ba National Park.
09:30:: Riding back to our boat have shower then before checking out
11:00:: A special lunch in Vietnamese cuisine of fresh seafood and an assortment of appetizing favorites are served while sailing through these islands
12:00:: Disembark to Beo Harbor. Then get on the bus back to Hanoi
16:00:: Arrive to Hanoi, tour end
Note: Due to weather, our itinerary may change to ensure guest safety and comfort. We adjust our route to avoid bad conditions, offering alternative beautiful destinations. Our experienced crew ensures a memorable journey, navigating smoothly regardless of the weather.
