3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.title: Bouttique Cruise 3 Days 2 Nights Cruise Lan Ha Bay
3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.itinerary:
A fantastic journey that covers most of the attractions in Lan Ha Bay and is well: organized. The tour allows you to explore famous sights comfortably. Sunlight Cruise turns ordinary experiences into extraordinary ones! HIGHLIGHTS & ADVICE:
DAY 1: HANOI – CAT BA – LAN HA BAY – LUNCH – KAYAKING VISIT TAI KEO LAGOON – DINNER – FISHING/KARAOKE (L, D):  
DAY 2: BREAKFAST – DARK AND BRIGHT CAVE – BACK CRUISE (B,L,D)
06: 00 Waking up enjoying beautiful moments when a blazing sunrise breaks the clouds of the island on the bay (accept winter time have no sunrise)
08: 00 Your breakfast will be ready in quite bay.
9: 00: Transfer to small boat to Dark and Bright cave area next to Halong Bay area, doing kayaking by your own through Dark and Bright cave explore Have lunch on local tender boat with local food serve then boat moving to other area for enjoy swimming
15: 00 Back to Sleeping boat for your 2nd night stay
19: 00 Dinner is served in the restaurant. Enjoy delicious local food prepared and served for you by our wonderful onboard catering staff.
20: 00 Happy hour free fresh local beer onboard with group. Overnight on boat Please be aware that the itinerary is subject to change due to weather conditions, which may necessitate adjustments by the organizing team to ensure the safety and enjoyment of the tour.
DAY 3 LAN HA – BIKING TO VIET HAI VILLAGE  - HANOI (B,L): 06.00 Waking up enjoying beautiful moments when a blazing sunrise breaks the clouds of the island on the bay (accept winter time have no sunrise)
07: 00: Have breakfast in restaurant , after moving to Viet Hai harbour for biking to the Village passing 5km. It is a wonderful place to ride a bike around for a half hour. The scenery is very pretty
11: 00 Lunch is served on boat, have good meal
12: 00 Disembark at to Beo Harbor. Get on the bus back to Hanoi, say goodbye Amazing Lan Ha Bay and Cat Ba Island
16: 00 Back to Hanoi. Tour guide will drop you back at your hotel
Note: Due to weather, our itinerary may change to ensure guest safety and comfort. We adjust our route to avoid bad conditions, offering alternative beautiful destinations. Our experienced crew ensures a memorable journey, navigating smoothly regardless of the weather.

3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.title: Boutique Cruise 3 Days 2 Nights Cruise Lan Ha Bay And Cat Ba Island Hotel/Bungalow
3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.itinerary:
3D2N (1N HOTEL + 1N ON CRUISE )
A fantastic journey covers most of the attractions in Lan Ha Bay and is well: organized. The tour takes you to explore beautifully famous sights in a comfortable way. Sunlight Cruises does ordinary things extraordinarily!
HIGHLIGHT: ADVICE:
DAY 1: HANOI - CATBA NATIONAL PARK- TRUNG TRANG  CAVE   ( L,D)
07:00: : Pick-up at hotels if located in the Hanoi Old Quarter by shuttle bus departing to Lan Ha Bay with stopovers for  refreshing en route.
12:000: : Arrive Hotel, check in and have lunch Afternoon: 14:00: Our local tour guide will take you to visit Cat Ba National Park  which is a tourist attraction to millions of domestic and oversea visitors. Coming to the Park, travelers not only could worship the beauty of landscapes, seascapes
16:00::  Keep moving to visit Trung Trang cave which has an ecosystem in mysterious darkness, home to many species of creatures such as bats, birds, insects and reptiles. The lighting system is very limited to preserve the characteristics of the ecological environment in the cave
17:00: : back to hotel and have dinner
Options::  Hotels:3,4 star, resorts
DAY 2: CATBA ISLAND HOTEL – LAN HA BAY  (B, L/D)
8:00: : Have Breakfast in Hotel , then have freetim walkig around
12:00: : Our bus pick you up to  Beo Harbor, transfer by tender to Sunlight Cruise, and enjoy welcome drinks, receive cruise briefing, safety instructions then check in to your cabin
13:00: : A special lunch in Vietnamese cuisine of fresh seafood and an assortment of appetizing favorites are served while sailing through these islands
14:30: : The cruise sails through Lan Ha Bay and completes its entry through the Cua Van  Area. The area is surrounded by extraordinary karst landscapes. Explore bay by your own kayaking through Dark & Bright caves
16:30::  Enjoy Swimming in a nearby area, you can join jumping from the top of the boat into water
18:00::  Come back to cruise later to enjoy cooking class with fresh spring roll
19:00: : Dinner is served in the restaurant. Enjoy delicious local food prepared and served for you by our wonderful onboard catering staff. After dinner you can do squid fishing or singing karaoke
20:00-21:00: Have : drinks and karaoke on Sundeck with group. Overnight on board
DAY 3: BIKING IN VIET HAI VILLAGE - HANOI  ( B/L).
06:00: : Waking up enjoying beautiful moments when a blazing sunrise breaks the clouds of the island on the bay (accept winter time have no sunrise)
07:00::  Your breakfast will be ready in quite a bay
08:00::  Start riding bicycle 5 km to Viet Hai Village , Viet Hai is a small village in the midst of jungles, covered by high mountains range of the Cat Ba National Park.
09:30::  Riding back to our boat have shower then before checking out
11:00::  A special lunch in Vietnamese cuisine of fresh seafood and an assortment of appetizing favorites are served while sailing through these islands
12:00::  Disembark to Beo Harbor. Then get on the bus back to Hanoi
16:00: : Arrive to Hanoi, tour end

Dora Cruise 3 Days 2 Nights Level 3, Hai An Group building, No.25, Lane 1 Lam Ha street, Long Bien, Hanoi. DISCOVERY HALONG BAY – LAN HA BAY (3 DAYS 2 NIGHTS) (Our itinerary is unique and different, we will take you to the less touristy and enchanted sceneries)
DAY 1: HANOI- HALONG – LAN HA ON DORA CRUISE ( L/ D)
08: 30 – 09:15: Our tour guide pick you up at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter. (if you use our limousine bus or private car)
09: 20: Departure to Halong Bay. You will have 1 short break during the way before arrive in Tuan Chau marina.
12: 00 – 12:15: Arrive to Tuan Chau harbor.
12: 30 – 13:15: Transferred by boat to Dora Cruise. Welcome to Dora Cruise and enjoy welcome drink, meet the captain, crew to get a brief introduction about cruise and safety guidelines. Check-in your cabin.
13: 15 – 13:30: Enjoy Vietnamese seafood and vegetarian lunch, while cruising in the magnificent Halong Bay, admiring the fascinating rock formations in the bay. – Continue cruising through Con Vit islet (Duck Islet), Thumb islet and Gia Luan Harbor where belonged to Cat Ba area.  – Discover lagoon natural area belonged to Lan Ha bay. Drop anchor for swimming or just simply sunbathe on our cruise (private, wild and fresh air). – Heading back toward the sleeping area – Do kayaking and swimming at Ba Trai Dao Islet or Tra Bau area where 
17.30: Come back to our Dora Cruise and participate in our sunset party with fruit, cake and wine. Take photos and relax
18: 00 – 18:15: Join cooking class guided directly by Chef of Dora Halong Cruise. You have chance to practice Vietnamese traditional dishes such as spring roll or famous cuisine of Vietnam
19: 15: Time for dinner enjoying special seafood and Vietnamese typical food on the cruise.
21: 00: Evening entertainments: play game on the cruise: cards game, chess, listen to music, squid fishing, relaxing and overnight on the Dora Cruise. DAY 2: TAI CHI– BREAFAST– CYCLING AT VIET HAI VILLAGE-VAN BOI BEACH –SUNSET PARTY ( B/ L/ D)
06: 00: Join us for a Tai Chi session for the early risers on the sun deck. Tai chi helps focus the mind and condition the body and there is no better environment to practice this than amongst the limestone peaks and islands.
07: 15: Joining light breakfast in a panorama view of the world heritage site. After breakfast, enjoy your time for relaxing in amazing view of the Lan Ha bay while the boat continues cruising further for sightseeing.
8: 45: Transfer to the Daily Boat heading to Viet Hai Village – a not touristic place surrounded by Cat Ba reserved jungle.
10.30: Visit Viet Hai Village Options:
+ Option 1: Do cycling around Viet Hai Village
+ Option 2: Use electric car to visit Viet Hai Village
12.00: Get back the day boat to continue cruising further in Lan Ha Bay. Enjoy the lunch with beautiful view.
13.00: 14.00: Arrive the peaceful area for swimming or Kayaking at the peaceful & beautiful Lan Ha bay. You will join the guide to kayak around the wonderful wide nature, clean water. There is a beautiful small beach named Three Peaches as the special shaped limestone mountains surrounding
15.00: We move on to some hidden beaches around Ba Trai Dao (Three Peaches) area and swimming there
17: 00 – 17:30: Back to Dora Cruise
18: 15: Take time to refresh or play some short game or with massage services as we cruise to sleeping area. Enjoy the Sunset Party & Cooking Class on the Sundeck. 19:15: Time for dinner enjoying special seafood and Vietnamese typical food on the cruise.
After dinner reward yourself with a large selection of cocktails at our bar, wine and cigars cellar or enjoy the landscape of the bay at night. Take one of our on: board activities like squid fishing, watching movies in the restaurant.
21: 00: Evening entertainments: play game on the cruise: cards game, chess, listen to music, squid fishing, relaxing and overnight on the Dora Cruise.
DAY 3: DORA LAN HA –  DARK & LIGHT CAVE – HA LONG CRUISE – HANOI ( B/L)
06.00: Early morning sun risers can enjoy Tai Chi lesson on sundeck.
07.15: Morning view of bay’s landscape with a cup of tea or coffee. Have breakfast.
8.15: You will be at reception to go visit Dark & Bright Cave by the tender (the transfer boat) to the small floating house and there you can have opportunity to explore the cave on local bamboo boat (rowing by the locals).
9: 30 – 10:15: Come back to Dora Cruise and check-out from the private cabin and enjoy a fantastic cruise on the bay.
10: 30: Have early lunch at the cruise before check out
11: 30: Dora Cruise are landing near Tuan Chau Harbor and transfer guest to Tuan Chau, say goodbye to Halong Bay and finish the cruise
12: 15: Return to gate 35, Tuan Chau marina and travel with our limousine bus to Hanoi Old Quarter
13: 50 – 14:00: Stopover in Hai Duong province to relax.
15: 30 – 16:00: Arrive in Hanoi
Notes: Cruise itinerary and schedule are subject to change without prior notice due to weather and operation conditions.

Doris Cruise 3 Days
DISCOVERY HA LONG BAY: LAN HA BAY ON DORIS CRUISE (Our itinerary is unique and different; we will take you to the less touristy and enchanted sceneries)
Day 01: Ha Long Bay – Lan Ha Bay – Sunset party – Cooking class (L/ D)
08: 00 – 08:30: Our driver will pick you up at your hotel in Hanoi old quarter (If you book our transfer service)
09: 00: Departure to Halong Bay for around 2.5 Hours with 20 minutes short break.
11: 30 – 12.00: Arrive Tuan Chau harbor 12:00 – 12:30 Get transfer to Doris Cruise by a tender boat.
Around 13: 00 – 13h15:  Warmly welcome to Doris Cruise and enjoy Welcome drink, meet the captain, crew to get a brief introduction about cruise and safety guidelines. Enjoy the lunch while cruising in the magnificent Halong Bay, admiring the fascinating rock formations in the bay. – Continue cruising through Con Vit islet (Duck Islet), Thumb islet and Gia Luan Harbour were belonged to Lan Ha Bay. Drop anchor for swimming or just simply sunbathe on the cruise (private, wild and fresh air). – Heading back toward the sleeping area
Check: in your cabin.
15h30: 17h00: Kayaking and swimming at Tra Bau area (the background of “Kong Skull Island movie”) or use Jacuzzi (Located prow of 3rd deck) Notice: Short close or or swim suite, flip flop is suitable for kayaking. Reception Provide: Life jackets; Towels, Dry bags (keep Camera, cellphone to take picture) Meeting point: The Reception (The back of the 1st Deck)
17.30: Come back to Doris Cruise and participate in our sunset party. Take photos and relax.
18.30: Join cooking class guided directly by Chef of Doris Halong Cruise. You have chance to practice Vietnamese traditional dishes such as spring roll or famous cuisine of Vietnam. Take advantage of the Happy hours “Buy 2 get 1 free” drink program at the Sky Bar
19.00: It is time for your romantic dinner
21.00: You are free for relaxing on cruise. Playing games, squid fishing, relaxing with massage service (on request) and stay overnight on the Doris Cruise.  
Day 02: Have Breakfast – Transfer To A Daily Boat – Cycling At Viet Hai Village – Kayaking – Swimming – Sunset Party – Overnight On Cruise (B/ L/ D)
Today we shall have a deeper exploration of Lan Ha Bay using our Small Day: Boat cruising through the multiple islands & islets, hidden beaches… also a short visit on bicycles to Viet Hai village, an isolated village in the very heart of Cat Ba National Park.  
06h00: Practice Taichi on the Sundeck 7h30 – 08h30: Have breakfast: Eggs, cake, coffee… You could skip it if you want to sleep more Prepare to bring: Swimsuits, cameras or cellphones, sandals or shoes, warm clothes (depends on the weather), sunglasses, cash if you buy drinks…. Hand houses keeping Card please 08h45 : Getting on the transfer boat to Viet Hai Village. 10h30 – 12h00: Options: + Option 1 : Do cycling around Viet Hai Village + Option 2: Use electric car to visit Viet Hai Village
12h: 12h20: Have lunch on the daily boat / VietHai Village restaurant 13h30-14h00: Kayaking around hidden Islands to explore the beauty and the hidden charm of Lan Ha bay 15h00 – 15:30 We move on to some hidden beaches around Ba Trai Dao (Three Peaches) area and swimming there 16h30 – 17h: Back to Doris Cruise 18h00: Enjoy Sunset Party and join the cooking demonstration, happy hour and relax. 19h30: Have dinner. 20h30: Evening entertainments: squid fishing, relaxing and spend the night on the Doris Cruise.
After dinner reward yourself with a large selection of cocktails at our bar, wine and cigars cellar or enjoy the landscape of the bay at night. Take one of our on: board activities like squid fishing, watching TV in your room. Stay overnight on Doris Cruise. You should bring
Day 03: Lan Ha Bay – Tai Chi Lesson – Dark and Bright Cave – Hanoi (B/ L)
06: 30: Early morning sun risers can enjoy Tai Chi lesson on sundeck.
07: 00-07:45: Have breakfast. Morning view of bay’s landscape with a cup of tea or coffee.
08: 00: Mingling yourself in the stunning views of the Bay and its dramatic limestone islets as we sail through the calm emerald waters heading to Dark & Bright Cave (Hang Sang & Toi), exploring the cave yourself on local bamboo boat rowed by the locals.
09: 30: Back to your cabin, take relax and check carefully all the luggage before leaving your cabin. Check-out from the private cabin and enjoy a fantastic cruise on the bay for room service. Complete check-out procedure.
10: 00: Enjoy your last buffet lunch at Doris cruise.
11: 30: Doris Cruise are landing Tuan Chau Harbor, tourist say goodbye to sailors and finish the cruise.

DISCOVERY HA LONG BAY: LAN HA BAY ON DORIS CRUISE (Our itinerary is unique and different; we will take you to the less touristy and enchanted sceneries)
Day 01: Ha Long Bay – Lan Ha Bay – Sunset party – Cooking class (L/ D)
08: 00 – 08:30: Our driver will pick you up at your hotel in Hanoi old quarter (If you book our transfer service)
09: 00: Departure to Halong Bay for around 2.5 Hours with 20 minutes short break.
11: 30 – 12.00: Arrive Tuan Chau harbor 12:00 – 12:30 Get transfer to Doris Cruise by a tender boat.
Around 13: 00 – 13h15:  Warmly welcome to Doris Cruise and enjoy Welcome drink, meet the captain, crew to get a brief introduction about cruise and safety guidelines. Enjoy the lunch while cruising in the magnificent Halong Bay, admiring the fascinating rock formations in the bay. – Continue cruising through Con Vit islet (Duck Islet), Thumb islet and Gia Luan Harbour were belonged to Lan Ha Bay. Drop anchor for swimming or just simply sunbathe on the cruise (private, wild and fresh air). – Heading back toward the sleeping area
Check: in your cabin.
15h30: 17h00: Kayaking and swimming at Tra Bau area (the background of “Kong Skull Island movie”) or use Jacuzzi (Located prow of 3rd deck) Notice: Short close or or swim suite, flip flop is suitable for kayaking. Reception Provide: Life jackets; Towels, Dry bags (keep Camera, cellphone to take picture) Meeting point: The Reception (The back of the 1st Deck)
17.30: Come back to Doris Cruise and participate in our sunset party. Take photos and relax.
18.30: Join cooking class guided directly by Chef of Doris Halong Cruise. You have chance to practice Vietnamese traditional dishes such as spring roll or famous cuisine of Vietnam. Take advantage of the Happy hours “Buy 2 get 1 free” drink program at the Sky Bar
19.00: It is time for your romantic dinner
21.00: You are free for relaxing on cruise. Playing games, squid fishing, relaxing with massage service (on request) and stay overnight on the Doris Cruise.  
Day 02: Have Breakfast – Transfer To A Daily Boat – Cycling At Viet Hai Village – Kayaking – Swimming – Sunset Party – Overnight On Cruise (B/ L/ D)
Today we shall have a deeper exploration of Lan Ha Bay using our Small Day: Boat cruising through the multiple islands & islets, hidden beaches… also a short visit on bicycles to Viet Hai village, an isolated village in the very heart of Cat Ba National Park.  
06h00: Practice Taichi on the Sundeck 7h30 – 08h30: Have breakfast: Eggs, cake, coffee… You could skip it if you want to sleep more Prepare to bring: Swimsuits, cameras or cellphones, sandals or shoes, warm clothes (depends on the weather), sunglasses, cash if you buy drinks…. Hand houses keeping Card please 08h45 : Getting on the transfer boat to Viet Hai Village. 10h30 – 12h00: Options: + Option 1 : Do cycling around Viet Hai Village + Option 2: Use electric car to visit Viet Hai Village
12h: 12h20: Have lunch on the daily boat / VietHai Village restaurant 13h30-14h00: Kayaking around hidden Islands to explore the beauty and the hidden charm of Lan Ha bay 15h00 – 15:30 We move on to some hidden beaches around Ba Trai Dao (Three Peaches) area and swimming there 16h30 – 17h: Back to Doris Cruise 18h00: Enjoy Sunset Party and join the cooking demonstration, happy hour and relax. 19h30: Have dinner. 20h30: Evening entertainments: squid fishing, relaxing and spend the night on the Doris Cruise.

3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.title: Discovery Halong bay – Lan Ha bay 3days/ 2nights
3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.itinerary:
Velar Of The Seas Cruise
Discovery Halong bay: Lan Ha bay 3days/ 2nights
3 DAYS: 2 NIGHTS ON BOAT DAY 1
11:45 : Arrive at Tuan Chau Harbor. 12:15-13:00 Transfer by tender boat to Velar of the seas cruise
13:15: Enjoy a fabulous lunch in our restaurant. During lunch time, our cruise starts to sail through the magnificent Lan Ha Bay, a geological extension of Halong Bay which is less visited, less inhabited and therefore has the extra appeal of being a more peaceful place. After lunchtime, you will have a short break before joining the ﬁrst activity of the tour.
14:15 – 15:30: Mingling yourself in the stunning views of the Bay and its dramatic limestone islets as we sail through the calm emerald waters heading to Dark & Bright Cave. Take your option either exploring the cave yourself on kayak or comfortably on local bamboo boat rowed by the locals. 17:00-17:30 It’s time to join in swimming activity on the sea at Tra Bau area. or relaxing in the swimming pool on the 1st deck.
17:45 : Enjoy the Sunset Party with fruits and snacks at Velar Sky Bar and Happy Hour will offer you a drink at an attractive price. Happy together, watching the Sun falling into the sea will be unforgettable memories for every single traveler on board.
18:00 : Our Vietnamese cooking demonstration is a great way to learn how to prepare delicious appetizers and we will guide you through the process.
19:00: You can spoil yourself with a unique Signature Dinner in our distinctive restaurant.
20:30 – 10:30: It is now time to relax with an exotic cocktail and drink in the evening landscape. Our bar offers a wide range of wine, beer, and liqueurs and is always a welcome sight for guests after a day sailing on the Bay. You can order an indulgent spa service, go squid ﬁshing or simply relax on our rooftop deck under the cover of a brightly illuminated sky. DAY 2
06:00: Be an early riser and attend healthy Tai Chi practice on the sundeck. Sunrise photography is awesome.
07:00: Enjoy breakfast in the restaurant.
07:50: You will join a day cruise and transfer to Viet Hai, a small village in the midst of jungles, covered by high mountains. The village is situated in the heart of Cat Ba National Park, which belongs to Cat Hai district of Hai Phong city.
10:30: Upon arrival, take a bike ride ( or electric car) along the small path through the rain forests. Enjoy stunning scenery of rice fields on the way, stop at the village to relax, and visit an ancient local house which is made from straw, mud,bamboo,… Arrive at Viet Hai, visit some local houses to learn about the culture, customs and daily life of the local people.
12:00: Back to the day cruise for a visit to Lan Ha Bay. Lunch will be served on board. 13:30 The cruise takes you to the pristine beach area- Ba Trai Dao beach. This is the most beautiful beach in Lan Ha Bay with nature amazing white sand, very quiet and fewer tourists, you are free to swim or participate in kayaking activity
14:45: Get on the day cruise for a transfer back and back to Velar of the Seas Cruise.
15:30: We return to Velar of the Seas Cruise and join some interesting activities such as cooking demonstration, sunset party and relax on the sundeck to catch the daily  spectacular of a gorgeous panorama.
19:00 : You can spoil yourself with a unique Signature Dinner in our distinctive   restaurant.
 20:30: It is now time to relax with an exotic cocktail and drink in the evening landscape. Our bar offers a wide range of wine, beer, and liqueurs and is always a welcome sight for guests after a day sailing on the Bay. You can order an indulgent spa service, go squid ﬁshing or simply relax on our rooftop deck under the cover of a brightly illuminated sky. playing games, singing karaoke….                              DAY 3
06:00 – 06:30: Greets ﬁrst light of the day on Sundeck, warming up your body with Tai Chi lesson or enjoy an early morning cup of tea, coffee or juice to watch the stunning scenery unfold before you
06:15 – 07:20: Light breakfast will be served in our restaurant (pastries, tea, coffee)
7: 20 – 08:00 Discover and explore “Nha Be Hai Phong” 09:00 – 09:30 Please pack and arrange all your luggage for check-out, placing it outside your room by 9:00 AM so our staff can collect it. You can return your room key and settle any outstanding bills.
09:30-10:20: Brunch will be served in the Restaurant on the 4th floor while we cruise gently back to the harbor.
10:30: We will take the tender to return to the dock
11:15: We arrive in Tuan Chau Marina
INCLUDED:: • 2 night in Velar of the seas cruise• 07 meals included: 02 Breakfast and 3 lunches + 2 dinner • Complimentary mineral water onboard (01 bottle/pax/day)• Sightseeing fees.• Onboard insurance and service charges.• Kayaking.
EXCLUDED:: • Transfers to and from Halong Bay, VISA service …• Airfare, Visa,• Beverages, spa and personal expenses.• VAT• All services not clearly mentioned
CHILDREN POLICY: • Free for under 6 year- old children sharing with their parent, only one child one cabin, second child will be charge 50%.• Charge 75% for the children from 6 to 9 year- old sharing with their parent.• Full charge for the children at 10 year-old and above.
*NOTES:: • Cruise itinerary and schedule are subject to change due to weather, tide levels and operating conditions without prior notice. • Swimming or kayaking excursions may be cancelled due to poor weather. • Meals on board are fusion: Vietnamese, seafood & international. Guests should advise of any specialfood preferences, allergies or dietary requirements at least one (01) week prior to the cruise date. • Advance registration is required prior to departure at least 3 days with your full name, date of birth,nationality, gender, passport number and visa expiration date for all passengers. A valid passport isrequired upon check-in. Otherwise, boarding may be denied by port authority.• Wi-Fi is available onboard free of charge. However, regular interruption is expected due to nature ofinternet signal at sea. Booking

3 DAYS: 2 NIGHTS ON BOAT DAY 1
11:45 : Arrive at Tuan Chau Harbor. 12:15-13:00 Transfer by tender boat to Velar of the seas cruise
13:15: Enjoy a fabulous lunch in our restaurant. During lunch time, our cruise starts to sail through the magnificent Lan Ha Bay, a geological extension of Halong Bay which is less visited, less inhabited and therefore has the extra appeal of being a more peaceful place. After lunchtime, you will have a short break before joining the ﬁrst activity of the tour.
14:15 – 15:30: Mingling yourself in the stunning views of the Bay and its dramatic limestone islets as we sail through the calm emerald waters heading to Dark & Bright Cave. Take your option either exploring the cave yourself on kayak or comfortably on local bamboo boat rowed by the locals. 17:00-17:30 It’s time to join in swimming activity on the sea at Tra Bau area. or relaxing in the swimming pool on the 1st deck.
17:45 : Enjoy the Sunset Party with fruits and snacks at Velar Sky Bar and Happy Hour will offer you a drink at an attractive price. Happy together, watching the Sun falling into the sea will be unforgettable memories for every single traveler on board.
18:00 : Our Vietnamese cooking demonstration is a great way to learn how to prepare delicious appetizers and we will guide you through the process.
19:00: You can spoil yourself with a unique Signature Dinner in our distinctive restaurant.
20:30 – 10:30: It is now time to relax with an exotic cocktail and drink in the evening landscape. Our bar offers a wide range of wine, beer, and liqueurs and is always a welcome sight for guests after a day sailing on the Bay. You can order an indulgent spa service, go squid ﬁshing or simply relax on our rooftop deck under the cover of a brightly illuminated sky. DAY 2
06:00: Be an early riser and attend healthy Tai Chi practice on the sundeck. Sunrise photography is awesome.
07:00: Enjoy breakfast in the restaurant.
07:50: You will join a day cruise and transfer to Viet Hai, a small village in the midst of jungles, covered by high mountains. The village is situated in the heart of Cat Ba National Park, which belongs to Cat Hai district of Hai Phong city.
10:30: Upon arrival, take a bike ride ( or electric car) along the small path through the rain forests. Enjoy stunning scenery of rice fields on the way, stop at the village to relax, and visit an ancient local house which is made from straw, mud,bamboo,… Arrive at Viet Hai, visit some local houses to learn about the culture, customs and daily life of the local people.
12:00: Back to the day cruise for a visit to Lan Ha Bay. Lunch will be served on board. 13:30 The cruise takes you to the pristine beach area- Ba Trai Dao beach. This is the most beautiful beach in Lan Ha Bay with nature amazing white sand, very quiet and fewer tourists, you are free to swim or participate in kayaking activity
14:45: Get on the day cruise for a transfer back and back to Velar of the Seas Cruise.
15:30: We return to Velar of the Seas Cruise and join some interesting activities such as cooking demonstration, sunset party and relax on the sundeck to catch the daily  spectacular of a gorgeous panorama.
19:00 : You can spoil yourself with a unique Signature Dinner in our distinctive   restaurant.
 20:30: It is now time to relax with an exotic cocktail and drink in the evening landscape. Our bar offers a wide range of wine, beer, and liqueurs and is always a welcome sight for guests after a day sailing on the Bay. You can order an indulgent spa service, go squid ﬁshing or simply relax on our rooftop deck under the cover of a brightly illuminated sky. playing games, singing karaoke….                              DAY 3
06:00 – 06:30: Greets ﬁrst light of the day on Sundeck, warming up your body with Tai Chi lesson or enjoy an early morning cup of tea, coffee or juice to watch the stunning scenery unfold before you
06:15 – 07:20: Light breakfast will be served in our restaurant (pastries, tea, coffee)
7: 20 – 08:00 Discover and explore “Nha Be Hai Phong” 09:00 – 09:30 Please pack and arrange all your luggage for check-out, placing it outside your room by 9:00 AM so our staff can collect it. You can return your room key and settle any outstanding bills.
09:30-10:20: Brunch will be served in the Restaurant on the 4th floor while we cruise gently back to the harbor.
10:30: We will take the tender to return to the dock
11:15: We arrive in Tuan Chau Marina

3 Days / 2 Nights Cruises.itinerary:
Tulip Cruise 3 Days 2 Nights Tulip Cruise 3 Days 2 Nights
DAY 1: TUAN CHAU PORT – LAN HA BAY – BA TRAI DAO BEACH (L/D)
08: 20 – 08:50. Pick up at your hotel lobby in Hanoi Old Quarter (If you book our limousine bus/ regular private car)
12: 15 – 12:30. Arrive at the waiting lounge for check-in. A transfer boat will take you to the Tulip Cruise
13: 00 – 13:30. Board Tulip Cruise at Finger Islet. Enjoy a welcome drink, safety briefing, and check-in, followed by a delightful lunch while admiring iconic rock formations such as Turtle Islet and Man Head Islet
15: 00. Arrive the peaceful area for swimming or Kayaking at the peaceful & beautiful Lan Ha bay. You will join the guide to kayak around the wonderful wide nature, clean water. There is a beautiful small beach named Three Peaches (Ba Trai Dao beach) as the special shaped limestone mountains surrounding
17: 00 – 17:15. Return to Tulip Cruise for swimming and kayaking near the cruise
17: 45. Enjoy sunset party with fresh fruits, cakes, tea and watch the sunset
18: 00. Join a cooking class with cruise’s chef
19: 15. Having Fine Dining dinner at the restaurant
20: 00 – 22:00. Evening leisure: enjoy music, try night squid fishing, relax, and overnight onboard Tulip Cruise
DAY 2: TRUNG TRANG CAVE – CAT BA NATIONAL PARK – CAT BA TOWN – LAN BAY(B/L/D)
06: 00 – 06:30. Join our morning Tai Chi session on the sundeck
06: 45 – 07:30. Enjoy a buffet breakfast amidst the panoramic view of the World Heritage seascape. After breakfast, relax while cruising further into the stunning Lan Ha Bay
08: 00. Transfer by speedboat to Beo Harbor, starting your Cat Ba Island excursion
08: 25. Arrive in Beo Habor and travel with the car to explore the Island
08: 50. Trung Trang Cave and Cat Ba National Park, where you can explore the primeval forest ecosystem or hike to Ngu Lam Peak for a breathtaking panoramic view.
12: 40. Head to Cat Ba Town and enjoy lunch at a local restaurant
13: 50. Free time for rest, shopping, or exploring the town at your own pace
15.15: Return to restaurant and transfer back to Beo Harbor by car
15.30: Return to the Beo Habor to take speedboat to the big boat
17: 45. Enjoy sunset party with fresh fruits, cakes, tea and watch the sunset
18: 00. Join our cooking class and afternoon tea party while admiring the sunset on the sundeck
19: 15. Having Fine Dining dinner at the restaurant After dinner reward yourself with a large selection of cocktails at our bars, wine and cigars cellar or enjoy the landscape of the bay at night. 
20: 30 – 22:00. Evening entertainments: play game on the cruise: cards game, chess, listen to music, squid fishing, relaxing and overnight on the Tulip Cruise
Notes: Prepare a good friction trekking shoes for Day 2’s excursion.
DAY 3: TULIP LAN HA – VIET HAI VILLAGE – HA LONG CRUISE – HANOI (B/L)
06: 00. Begin the day with a Tai Chi session on the sundeck
06: 45 – 07:30. Morning view of bay’s landscape with a cup of tea or coffee. Have light breakfast
07: 45 – 08:00: Visit Viet Hai Village by bicycle or electric car to explore the peaceful local life or stay on boat to enjoy mini golf or do swimming and kayaking on the bay
10: 00. Return to Tulip Cruise and prepare for check-out
10: 30. Enjoy the lunch on board 
11: 45. Say goodbye to the crew and get on the transfer boat back Tuan Chau Harbor
12: 15 – 12:20: Come back to Tuan Chau Harbor
Notes: Cruise itinerary and schedule are subject to change without prior notice due to weather and operation conditions. TOUR INCLUSION TOUR EXCLUSION Bài viết liên quan Tulip Cruise 2 Days 1 Night Services Contact Info

Lan Ha Bay Cruise 2 Days 1 Night Itinerary
( Ha Long Bay: Lan Ha Bay) Lan Ha Bay cruise is one of the best ways to explore the peaceful beauty of Ha Long Bay and Lan Ha Bay. Our 2 days 1 night itinerary with Sena Cruises offers a boutique luxury journey through these stunning limestone landscapes. Lan Ha Bay is one of the most beautiful and tranquil areas of Ha Long Bay, known for its emerald waters and dramatic limestone islands. Its quiet routes and untouched scenery make it an ideal destination for travelers seeking a peaceful cruise experience.
To discover more about the highlights of this region, read our guide: Things to do in Lan Ha Bay.
DAY 1: HANOI – LAN HA BAY JOURNEY
07:45 – 08:30 | Pick-up in Hanoi
For those who book transfer service, our bus will collect guests from hotels around Hanoi Old Quarter. The exact pick: up time will be informed later by the evening before the departure date.
11:30 – 12:00 | Arrive Tuan Chau Harbor
12:00 – 12:15 | Transfer to the main boat by tender. Embark on Sena Cruises: Warmly welcome to Sena Cruises! While enjoying a welcome drink, our cruise manager will deliver a cruise briefing and safety introduction. After that you will check in your cabin.
13:00 – 13:15 | Lunch on board while sailing to Lan Ha Bay
Our crew serves a fabulous lunch while Sena Cruises sails into Lan Ha Bay: an extension of Ha Long Wonder which is much quieter and has fewer tourists. She will pass a thousands of uniquely shaped limestone towers and islands.
15:00 | Explore Lan Ha Bay
We will visit the Dark and Bright Cave: famous for the pristine natural beauty and poetic, attractive seascape of Lan Ha Bay. Here you will take some photos of the romantic, lyrical local see-sights. This is also the best time for tourists to enjoy a sampan boat ride rowed by a local or kayaking – which is an interesting activity to discover the truest beauty of the limestone mountains and the blue sky of Lan Ha Bay. 17:00 | Return to Sena Cruises  Enjoy a sunset party on Lan Ha Bay. It is an ideal time for photography enthusiasts to capture the stunning moment of sunset at Lan Ha Bay. You will also have a chance to join our Cooking class to challenge your skills in preparing very famous Vietnamese spring rolls. Before dinner, our experienced captain will choose the most tranquil area to anchor for overnight.
19:00 | Savor deluxe dinner
Reward yourself with a large selection of cocktails at a panoramic bar or take one of our onboard activities: karaoke, squid fishing (we open the light and prepare the squid fishing rods). You will stay overnight on cruise.
DAY 2: MORNING CRUISE AND RETURN TO HANOI
06:00 | Sunrise Tai-chi section on sundeck
Be an early bird for a photo hunt and join our Tai: chi session on the sundeck to refresh your body and mind.
07:00 | Having light breakfast
Sena Cruises: Luxury Boutique Cruises continues her sail, passing amazing karst towers. Tea, coffee and light breakfast is served with fresh air and peaceful surroundings.
08:00 | Explore Tra Bau Area
Join kayaking & swimming to explore the Tra Bau area: the famous filming location for Kong Skull Island (King Kong) in Quang Ninh in 2018.
09:00 – 09:30 | Return to the boat for check-out
09:45 – 10:00 | Lunch time
During the time well prepared lunch is served, Sena Cruises: Luxury Boutique Cruise slowly navigates emerald water and thousands of Karst Mountains towards the Harbor. (If you want to go to Cat Ba Island after cruise, we will transfer you by Sena Cruises tender boat to Gia Luan Port. please inform in advance).
11:30 – 12:00 | Disembark Sena Cruises. Farewell the crew and back to Hanoi by bus
15:00 – 15:30 | Arrive at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter, end of unforgettable trip.
Notes: Itineraries may be subject to change without prior notice due to weather, pandemic conditions, or regulation of Port authorities. Wi-Fi is available in the restaurant/bar area, but internet connectivity is limited due to the geography of the bay. Thank you for your understanding. If you would like to explore Lan Ha Bay more deeply, consider extending your journey with our 3 Days 2 Nights cruise. The longer itinerary allows you to discover quieter areas of the bay, visit Viet Hai Village on Cat Ba Island, and enjoy more kayaking, cycling, and beach activities.

12:00 – 12:15 | Transfer to the main boat by tender. Embark on Sena Cruises: Warmly welcome to Sena Cruises! While enjoying a welcome drink, our cruise manager will deliver a cruise briefing and safety introduction. After that you will check in your cabin.
13:00 – 13:15 | Lunch on board while sailing to Lan Ha Bay
Our crew serves a fabulous lunch while Sena Cruises sails into Lan Ha Bay: an extension of Ha Long Wonder which is much quieter and has fewer tourists. She will pass a thousands of uniquely shaped limestone towers and islands.
15:00 | Explore Lan Ha Bay
We will visit the Dark and Bright Cave: famous for the pristine natural beauty and poetic, attractive seascape of Lan Ha Bay. Here you will take some photos of the romantic, lyrical local see-sights. This is also the best time for tourists to enjoy a sampan boat ride rowed by a local or kayaking – which is an interesting activity to discover the truest beauty of the limestone mountains and the blue sky of Lan Ha Bay. 17:00 | Return to Sena Cruises  Enjoy a sunset party on Lan Ha Bay. It is an ideal time for photography enthusiasts to capture the stunning moment of sunset at Lan Ha Bay. You will also have a chance to join our Cooking class to challenge your skills in preparing very famous Vietnamese spring rolls. Before dinner, our experienced captain will choose the most tranquil area to anchor for overnight.
19:00 | Savor deluxe dinner
Reward yourself with a large selection of cocktails at a panoramic bar or take one of our onboard activities: karaoke, squid fishing (we open the light and prepare the squid fishing rods). You will stay overnight on cruise.
DAY 2: MORNING CRUISE AND RETURN TO HANOI
06:00 | Sunrise Tai-chi section on sundeck
Be an early bird for a photo hunt and join our Tai: chi session on the sundeck to refresh your body and mind.
07:00 | Having light breakfast
Sena Cruises: Luxury Boutique Cruises continues her sail, passing amazing karst towers. Tea, coffee and light breakfast is served with fresh air and peaceful surroundings.
08:00 | Explore Tra Bau Area
Join kayaking & swimming to explore the Tra Bau area: the famous filming location for Kong Skull Island (King Kong) in Quang Ninh in 2018.
09:00 – 09:30 | Return to the boat for check-out
09:45 – 10:00 | Lunch time
During the time well prepared lunch is served, Sena Cruises: Luxury Boutique Cruise slowly navigates emerald water and thousands of Karst Mountains towards the Harbor. (If you want to go to Cat Ba Island after cruise, we will transfer you by Sena Cruises tender boat to Gia Luan Port. please inform in advance).
11:30 – 12:00 | Disembark Sena Cruises. Farewell the crew and back to Hanoi by bus
15:00 – 15:30 | Arrive at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter, end of unforgettable trip.
Notes: Itineraries may be subject to change without prior notice due to weather, pandemic conditions, or regulation of Port authorities. Wi-Fi is available in the restaurant/bar area, but internet connectivity is limited due to the geography of the bay. Thank you for your understanding. If you would like to explore Lan Ha Bay more deeply, consider extending your journey with our 3 Days 2 Nights cruise. The longer itinerary allows you to discover quieter areas of the bay, visit Viet Hai Village on Cat Ba Island, and enjoy more kayaking, cycling, and beach activities.
Explore the full itinerary here: Explore Ha Long Bay on Sena Cruises 3 Days. Ready to experience the beauty of Lan Ha Bay? Check availability for your preferred travel date or contact us to plan your perfect cruise journey with Sena Cruises.

The Bai Tu Long Bay 3 days 2 nights cruise is a perfect choice for travelers who want a quieter and more authentic experience in Halong Bay. This itinerary by Swan Cruises focuses on peaceful routes, hidden lagoons and local fishing villages. Instead of crowded tourist areas, you will explore less: visited parts of the bay while still enjoying kayaking, cave visits and relaxing cruise activities. If you prefer a shorter itinerary, you can explore our Bai Tu Long Bay 2 days 1 night cruise for a quicker but still memorable experience. Included in this Cruise Exlusion in this Cruise Addinformation in this Cruise
1. Schedule and activities:: 2. Menu and meals: DAY 1
HANOI: BAI TU LONG BAY – CONG DO – CAP LA ISLAND ( L,D)
07.45 – 8.30:: Our bus will pick you up from your hotel in Hanoi and start your trip to explore the most amazing bay in the North of Vietnam. On the way, we will have a quick stop in the middle of the way to rest.
11.40 - 12.00:: Arrive at our waiting lounge at Ha Long international cruise port, you will have a bit of time to relax. Wait for our captain to finish the registration and transfer by tender to our boat Swan Cruises.
12.30:: Enjoy a welcome drink and spend a couple of minutes briefing about safety on the boat and activities included then we check in our cabin.
13.00:: Delicious Vietnamese set menu will be served while leisurely cruising further into Bai Tu Long Bay.
15.00:: Arrive in the kayaking area – that is Cap La Island. Enjoy kayaking through the karst and breathtaking nature, swimming and relaxing.
17.00:: Get back to the boat and enjoy our Sunset party while our cruise sailing to the overnight anchorage. Attend a Vietnamese cooking demonstration. You can quickly learn a simple but delicious Vietnamese dish that Gordon Ramsey (a 2 Michelin Star Chef) used to guide – Nem Cuon or challenge yourself in fruit and vegetable carving.
19.00:: Sumptuous set dinner on board.
20.30:: Free time to challenge yourself in Vietnamese puzzle games, or gathers your group/family for a board game, karaoke, try your luck with squid fishing or simply have a cocktail and enjoy the quiet night on the bay. DAY 2 FULL DAY ACTIVITIES IN THE BAY (B, L, D)
06.00: Start your day with a Tai Chi routine on the sundeck or catch a morning view of the stunning bay’s landscape with a cup of tea or coffee.
07.00: Breakfast will be served in Western style, familiar to you to fulfill your strength and ready for another exploring day.
08.30: Transfer to another small day boat to go deeper into the bay.
09.30: 11.00: Pick up the kayak from the only designated shared raft (same spot as Day 1), then paddle to explore Thay Cave and enjoy swimming around the area.
11.30: 13.00: A delicious lunch at noontime is served.
13.00: 14.00: Visit Vung Vieng fishing village and pearl farming.
14.30: 15.00: Return to the main Swan Cruise boat; take a break, enjoy the sunset party afterward and Cooking Class.
19.00: Dinner will be served.
20.30: 22.00: Free time for joining games, karaoke, you may also try your luck with squid fishing. DAY 3
BAI TU LONG BAY: THIEN CANH SON CAVE – HALONG PORT (B, L)
06.00:: Sunrise Tai-chi section on sundeck or catch a morning view of the stunning bay’s landscape with a cup of tea or coffee.
06.30:: Breakfast will be served in Western style, familiar to you to fulfill your strength and ready for another exploring day.
07.30 - 07.45:: Explore the well-hidden Thien Canh Son Cave.
08.30:: Upon return to the boat you will have about 30 minutes to freshen up and finish packing.
10.00:: Enjoy a traditional Vietnamese lunch on the boat.
10.30:: Cruises back to the harbor.
11.00 - 11.30:: Disembark at Ha Long cruise port.
11.30 - 12.00:: Our bus will take you back to Hanoi.
15.00 - 15.30:: End of service.

Bai Tu Long Bay: 3 Days 2 Nights Cruise  Discover the beauty of Bai Tu Long Bay on a 3 days 2 nights cruise, exploring peaceful waters, hidden caves, and traditional floating villages far from the crowded routes of Halong Bay. Journey Deeper into Bai Tu Long Bay The 3 days 2 nights Bai Tu Long Bay cruise offers an extended journey to explore the quieter and more untouched side of Halong Bay. This itinerary takes you deeper into Bai Tu Long Bay, where dramatic limestone islands rise from emerald waters and the atmosphere remains peaceful and uncrowded.
During the trip, you will kayak through the stunning karst landscape at Cap La, visit the floating fishing village of Vung Vieng, explore hidden caves, and relax on quiet beaches. With more time on the bay, this cruise allows you to truly slow down, enjoy the scenery, and experience an authentic off: the-beaten-path adventure in Bai Tu Long Bay. Contact now Reserve this room

The 3: day itinerary allows you to travel deeper into Bai Tu Long Bay, visit more secluded areas, enjoy longer kayaking sessions, and experience local life at floating fishing villages. Activities include kayaking through limestone karsts, visiting Vung Vieng floating village, exploring caves, swimming at quiet beaches, Tai Chi in the morning, and squid fishing at night. Day 2 takes you further into the bay to explore quieter areas such as Cong Dam. Guests can enjoy kayaking, swimming, relaxing on secluded beaches, and experiencing the peaceful natural scenery of Bai Tu Long Bay. Lan Ha Bay Cruise 3 Days 2 Night Itinerary
( Ha Long Bay: Lan Ha Bay) Lan Ha Bay cruise is one of the best ways to explore the peaceful beauty of Ha Long Bay and Lan Ha Bay. Our 3 days 2 nights itinerary with Sena Cruises offers a boutique luxury journey through these stunning limestone landscapes. Lan Ha Bay is one of the most beautiful and tranquil areas of Ha Long Bay, known for its emerald waters and dramatic limestone islands. Its quiet routes and untouched scenery make it an ideal destination for travelers seeking a peaceful cruise experience.
To discover more about the highlights of this region, read our guide: Things to do in Lan Ha Bay. If you prefer a shorter journey, you can also explore our 2 Days 1 Night Lan Ha Bay cruise itinerary.
DAY 1: HANOI – LAN HA BAY
07:45 – 08:30 | Pick-up in Hanoi
For those who book transfer service, our bus will collect guests from hotels around Hanoi Old Quarter. The exact pick: up time will be informed later by the evening before the departure date.
11:30 – 12:00 | Arrive Tuan Chau Harbor
12:00 – 12:15 | Transfer to the main boat by tender. Embark on Sena Cruises: Warmly welcome to Sena Cruises! While enjoying a welcome drink, our cruise manager will deliver a cruise briefing and safety introduction. After that you will check in your cabin.
13:00 – 13:15 | Lunch on board while sailing to Lan Ha Bay
Our crew serves a fabulous lunch while Sena Cruises sails into Lan Ha Bay: an extension of Ha Long Wonder which is much quieter and has fewer tourists. She will pass a thousands of uniquely shaped limestone towers and islands.
15:00 | Explore Lan Ha Bay
We will visit the Dark and Bright Cave: famous for the pristine natural beauty and poetic, attractive seascape of Lan Ha Bay. Here you will take some photos of the romantic, lyrical local see-sights. This is also the best time for tourists to enjoy a sampan boat ride rowed by a local or kayaking – which is an interesting activity to discover the truest beauty of the limestone mountains and the blue sky of Lan Ha Bay.  17:00 | Return to Sena Cruises  Enjoy a sunset party on Lan Ha Bay. It is an ideal time for photography enthusiasts to capture the stunning moment of sunset at Lan Ha Bay. You will also have a chance to join our Cooking class to challenge your skills in preparing very famous Vietnamese spring rolls. Before dinner, our experienced captain will choose the most tranquil area to anchor for overnight.
19:00 | Savor deluxe dinner
Reward yourself with a large selection of cocktails at a panoramic bar or take one of our onboard activities: karaoke, squid fishing (we open the light and prepare the squid fishing rods). You will stay overnight on cruise.
DAY 2: VIET HAI VILLAGE AND LAN HA BAY EXPLORATION
06:00 | Sunrise Tai-chi section on sundeck
Be an early bird for a photo hunt and join our Tai: chi session on the sundeck to refresh your body and mind.
07:00 | Have light breakfast
08:30 | Transfer to the Viet Hai by a small day boat: Viet Hai Village, located in Cat Ba Island, Vietnam, is a picturesque ancient village surrounded by lush greenery and majestic limestone mountains. The village offers a glimpse into Vietnam’s rich cultural heritage with its traditional houses made from natural materials. Visitors can explore the village’s serene landscapes, enjoy bike or tram rides through trails, and immerse themselves in the peaceful ambiance.
12:30 | Have lunch  
13:30 | The cruise takes you to the pristine bay area : Activities like swimming, sunbathing, and kayaking from the day boat make it an ideal destination for relaxation and adventure. Discover the pristine beauty of Lan Ha Bay and create unforgettable memories in this hidden gem of Vietnam.
15:00 – 16:00 | Go back to Sena Cruises: Return to the main boat for the second night onboard. The sequence of activities will occur again, feel free to either join the next scheduled session with new groups or enjoy some undisturbed leisure time on the cruise. Relax on the sundeck and enjoy “Happy Hour Deal” in all bars.
19:00 | Enjoy dinner: You may take the rest of the night with drinks on the sundeck, relax in your room, karaoke or try your luck with catching squids. Staying overnight on cruise.
DAY 3: LAN HA BAY – HANOI
06:00 | Sunrise Tai-chi section on sundeck
Be an early bird for a photo hunt and join our Tai: chi session on the sundeck to refresh your body and mind.
07:00 | Having light breakfast
Sena Cruises: Luxury Boutique Cruises continues her sail, passing amazing karst towers. Tea, coffee and light breakfast is served with fresh air and peaceful surroundings.
08:00 | Explore Tra Bau Area
Join kayaking & swimming to explore the Tra Bau area: the famous filming location for Kong Skull Island (King Kong) in Quang Ninh in 2018.
09:00 – 09:30 | Return to the boat for check-out
09:45 – 10:00 | Lunch time
During the time well prepared lunch is served, Sena Cruises: Luxury Boutique Cruise slowly navigates emerald water and thousands of Karst Mountains towards the Harbor.
(If you want to go to Cat Ba Island after cruise, we will drop you at Gia Luan Port by tender boat at 10: 30 AM. Please inform in advance).
11:30 – 12:00 | Disembark Sena Cruises. Farewell the crew and back to Hanoi by bus
15:00 – 15:30 | Arrive at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter, end of unforgettable trip.
Notes: Itineraries may be subject to change without prior notice due to weather, pandemic conditions, or regulation of Port authorities. Wi-Fi is available in the restaurant/bar area, but internet connectivity is limited due to the geography of the bay. Thank you for your understanding.
